Comments (English): [ Bosch Saga: Two defective Dishwashers ] || ---------------- || My prior Bosch 800 dishwasher provided excellent cleaning and was trouble free for 12 years. So I was pleased to see Costco carrying Bosch dishwashers. Unfortunately, I'm in the process of exchanging a second Bosch 500 dishwasher due to functional defects and can only speculate about the quality of the products sold through Costco versus other Bosch retailers. Cosmetically, both dishwashers appeared solid and were scratch free. Costco customer service and warranty support personal have been pleasant and efficient. Similarly, Costco logistics and their contracted delivery service were flawless. Still, the frustration of receiving two defective dishwashers coupled with the inconvenience of not having a dishwasher and the direct expense of multiple installations has made me rethink purchasing appliances from Costco. Costco does not provide dishwasher installation in my area, so I hired a plumber for what I expected to be a one-time installation service. Now, with multiple installations needed, my installation expense skyrocketed. Also, missing parts and required rescheduling led to additional delays.First defective dishwasher: The dishwasher appeared fine and readily hooked up to Wi-Fi. But, the test cycle revealed a gushing leak from the bottom of the rinse aid dispenser. More problematic, the test cycle produced a motor oil smell. Costco technical support confirmed that the dishwasher absolutely should not exude a machine oil smell. So, annoyed at paying for installation of a defective product, I opted to exchange the dishwasher and paid for another service call to unhook the dishwasher for pick-up. Second dishwasher: prior to installation, I tested the integrity of the rinse aid dispenser. Shockingly, the dispenser failed to hold liquid. After speaking with two Costco representatives about the rinse aid dispensers, I decided to try one more exchange. Hopefully, the third dishwasher will be fully functioning.

Sentence (English): I've finally upgraded my kitchen with the Bosch 800 Series Dishwasher, and I can honestly say it's been a game-changer.
Comments (English): [ A Sparkling Clean Revelation ] || ---------------- || I've finally upgraded my kitchen with the Bosch 800 Series Dishwasher, and I can honestly say it's been a game-changer. I had heard whispers of its quiet operation and superior cleaning, but experiencing it firsthand has truly exceeded my expectations. This isn't just a dishwasher; it's an investment in convenience and a sparkling clean kitchen. First and foremost, the silence is golden. My old dishwasher sounded like a jet engine taking off, making conversation in the kitchen impossible. The 800 Series? I often have to double-check to make sure it's even running. It's so quiet, you can barely hear it, even when standing right next to it. This has made a huge difference in the ambiance of my home, especially since my kitchen is open to the living area. Beyond the whisper-quiet operation, the cleaning performance is outstanding. Dishes come out spotless and dry every single time. Even notoriously challenging items like casserole dishes and heavily soiled pots are no match for this machine. I've noticed a significant reduction in the need to pre-wash or re-wash dishes, saving me both time and water. Now, let's talk about the features. The adjustable top rack was a revelation! I didn't realize how much I needed this until I had it. Being able to lower or raise the top rack allows for incredible flexibility in loading, accommodating everything from tall wine glasses to bulky serving platters with ease. It's a small detail that makes a big difference in maximizing the dishwasher's capacity. The Home Connect app is another fantastic addition. While I initially thought it might be a bit gimmicky, I've found it to be surprisingly useful. Being able to customize settings, start the dishwasher remotely, and receive notifications on my phone is incredibly convenient. I especially appreciate the cycle status updates, so I know exactly where the dishwasher is in its cycle. The app also offers a range of specialized wash cycles, allowing for even more tailored cleaning. Overall, the Bosch 800 Series Dishwasher is worth every penny. It's quiet, powerful, and packed with thoughtful features that make dishwashing a breeze. If you're looking for a dishwasher that delivers exceptional performance and elevates your kitchen experience, I highly recommend the Bosch 800 Series. It's truly a worthwhile investment that you won't regret.

Sentence (English): I brought a dishwasher to my house.
Comments (English): I brought a dishwasher to my house. It's small, but it's packed with features. I'd have preferred a built-in dishwasher, but space is limited, so I'm stuck with a six-person dishwasher. Sentence (English): There was a reason for the low rating (4.5).
Comments (English): [ Hmm. Low sales ranking compared to product reviews. ] || ---------------- || There was a reason for the low rating (4.5). The Miele dishwasher that was installed when I got the apartment was removed when I redecorated the house, with the plastic still on, without being used once in 20 years. It's not easy to find a new, good dishwasher, so I thought it was a third-generation dishwasher, so I bought it based on the following criteria: good reviews, a window so I could see inside, the door opening automatically, not too deep, and a rocket-type installation. Is that the problem? The size is as expected, but as long as the depth isn't an issue, I'd like to say that you should buy a product with a high sales ranking that can hold as much as possible. And I don't know if it's because I can't use it, but I can't even put in a few dishes or what;; There's no separate detergent container, and it just says to place it in a slightly recessed area on the inside of the door (the manual says so), but when the door closes, it's so deep and structured that it just falls down with a plop. And the person who installed it did the general setting and it ran for 65 minutes, but even though the drying process clearly includes it, it's not dry at all and the water is soaking wet. It's not just not fully dry or not completely dry, it's soaking wet like before the dishwasher was used. And there's no separate drying function, so I'm wondering if I should run the sterilization and drying cycle again or what this thing is for. And it would have been nice if they had put in a little detergent, even as a sample. It's not like that in many ways. I want to exchange it for an installed product or something else, but I can't move something that's already been installed to another place. Since I bought it directly from Coupang, I thought there wouldn't be any after-sales service issues, but the performance itself is a problem even before the after-sales service. I don't understand whether the people who leave good reviews here have low expectations. Anyway, I'm really worried. I bought a few tablets that are supposed to be eco-friendly detergent, but... The Miele dishwasher that was installed when I got the apartment was removed when I redecorated the house, with the plastic still on, without being used once in 20 years. It's not easy to find a new, good dishwasher, so I thought it was a third-generation dishwasher, so I bought it based on the following criteria: good reviews, a window so I could see inside, the door opening automatically, not too deep, and a rocket-type installation. Is that the problem? The size is as expected, but as long as the depth isn't an issue, I'd like to say that you should buy a product with a high sales ranking that can hold as much as possible. And I don't know if it's because I can't use it, but I can't even put in a few dishes or what;; There's no separate detergent container, and it just says to place it in a slightly recessed area on the inside of the door (the manual says so), but when the door closes, it's so deep and structured that it just falls down with a plop. And the person who installed it did the general setting and it ran for 65 minutes, but even though the drying process clearly includes it, it's not dry at all and the water is soaking wet. It's not just not fully dry or not completely dry, it's soaking wet like before the dishwasher was used. And there's no separate drying function, so I'm wondering if I should run the sterilization and drying cycle again or what this thing is for. And it would have been nice if they had put in a little detergent, even as a sample. It's not like that in many ways. I want to exchange it for an installed product or something else, but I can't move something that's already been installed to another place. Since I bought it directly from Coupang, I thought there wouldn't be any after-sales service issues, but the performance itself is a problem even before the after-sales service. I don't understand whether the people who leave good reviews here have low expectations. Anyway, I'm really worried. I bought a few tablets that are supposed to be eco-friendly detergent, but... Since there is no detergent container, I used it twice on the first day and was disappointed, so I just hand washed it without putting it in the dishwasher and went back to using the dryer I was using before. Hmm. I will use it again to see if mine is defective or not and leave an additional review.

Comments (English): Hello. This is a review of my 14-seater dishwasher. My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. I'm so upset I missed the sale. If you found this review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you.

Sentence (English): My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one.
Comments (English): Hello. This is a review of my 14-seater dishwasher. My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. I'm so upset I missed the sale. If you found this review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you.

Sentence (English): 14-seater?
Comments (English): Hello. This is a review of my 14-seater dishwasher. My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. I'm so upset I missed the sale. If you found this review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you.

(사진첨부)5. 세제투입올인원 타블렛을 쓰는 경우 문쪽통에 넣지.않고세번째 바스켓에.따로 넣는 자리가 있어서이거 은근 편합니다. (사진첨부)6. 자동문열림.7년전 모델은 이 기능이 없었는데 세상편함.7. 가격가격변동이 꽤 있네여.105에 구입했는데 98까지 할인되는거 보고 후기 쓸 맛이 뚝 떨어졌는데제품 자체는 좋으니 가격 비교 잘 하고 구입하시길 바랍니다.할인 놓쳐서 배아픈데이 후기가 도움이 되셨다면 도움돼요 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다.  ㅋㅋ감사합니다.

Sentence (English): Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids.
Comments (English): Hello. This is a review of my 14-seater dishwasher. My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. I'm so upset I missed the sale. If you found this review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you.

(사진첨부)6. 자동문열림.7년전 모델은 이 기능이 없었는데 세상편함.7. 가격가격변동이 꽤 있네여.105에 구입했는데 98까지 할인되는거 보고 후기 쓸 맛이 뚝 떨어졌는데제품 자체는 좋으니 가격 비교 잘 하고 구입하시길 바랍니다.할인 놓쳐서 배아픈데이 후기가 도움이 되셨다면 도움돼요 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다.  ㅋㅋ감사합니다.

Comments (English): Hello. This is a review of my 14-seater dishwasher. My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. I'm so upset I missed the sale. If you found this review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you.

Comments (English): Hello. This is a review of my 14-seater dishwasher. My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. I'm so upset I missed the sale. If you found this review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you.

(사진첨부)5. 세제투입올인원 타블렛을 쓰는 경우 문쪽통에 넣지.않고세번째 바스켓에.따로 넣는 자리가 있어서이거 은근 편합니다. (사진첨부)6. 자동문열림.7년전 모델은 이 기능이 없었는데 세상편함.7. 가격가격변동이 꽤 있네여.105에 구입했는데 98까지 할인되는거 보고 후기 쓸 맛이 뚝 떨어졌는데제품 자체는 좋으니 가격 비교 잘 하고 구입하시길 바랍니다.할인 놓쳐서 배아픈데이 후기가 도움이 되셨다면 도움돼요 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다.  ㅋㅋ감사합니다.

Comments (English): Hello. This is a review of my 14-seater dishwasher. My 12-seater LG dishwasher broke down after 7 years, so I bought a new one. Since I did some quick research and made the purchase, I'll write down the pros and cons in detail. 1. 14-seater? I felt the 12-seater was a bit small for a 4-person household, so I looked into the 14-seater. The price difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is about 20-30 cents. Despite that, I insisted on the 14-seater, believing it would be a better value. Upon receiving the dishwasher, it was the same size as the 12-seater. The external dimensions are different due to the sink size, but I expected the internal dimensions to be different. The difference between the 12-seater and 14-seater is the denser internal shelf structure. It's called the 14-seater because it can hold more dishes. Had I known, I would have bought the 12-seater. (This applies to both Samsung and LG models.) But... After using it, I found that it does hold more dishes. 2. Pros and Cons of the Internal Shelf. Since it's a 14-person dishwasher, the internal shelves are tightly packed, so you can fit a lot of plates, but it's a bit awkward to place deep dishes like spaghetti plates or pot lids. The shelves are fixed, so you have to force them in. The second basket can be adjusted up and down, which is very useful. 3. This model supports TrueSteam (100°C), but not hot air drying. Honestly, dishwashers clean at high temperatures, so do you really need both? Each additional feature adds $10 to the price. I already had a model without both features, so I didn't need them. It's hard to find a model without both, so I purchased a model with only TrueSteam. After researching, I found that many reviews said the hot drying feature took too long and was too expensive to use. I recommend TrueSteam to anyone who uses baby bottles. I'll probably use it occasionally when my family is sick (like with enteritis or the flu), so I recommend this model as a cost-effective option. 4. Cleaning Power. This washer definitely washes better than the one I bought seven years ago. It even cleans stacks of dishes well. I use an all-in-one tablet, and I love that it barely leaves any water stains, even without having to add rinse aid or salt. Even with just an hour and a half of automatic washing, it's still clean and there's barely any water stains. (Photo attached) 5. Detergent. With the all-in-one tablet, instead of putting it in the door compartment, there's a separate compartment in the third basket. This is surprisingly convenient. (Photo attached) 6. Automatic door opening. The model from seven years ago didn't have this feature, so it's incredibly convenient. 7. Price. Prices fluctuate quite a bit. I bought it for $105, but when I saw it on sale for $98, I lost all motivation to write a review. The product itself is good, so please compare prices carefully before purchasing. I'm so upset I missed the sale. If you found this review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you.

I never once used the Miele dishwasher that came with my apartment when I bought it; I removed it with the protective film still on during a renovation. I heard it was a "third-generation housekeeper," so I bought it hastily based on criteria like good reviews, a window to look inside, automatic door opening, not being too deep, and "rocket installation." Was it a problem that I made this purchase so impulsively? The size is exactly as I expected, but as long as the depth isn't an issue, it fits as much as possible. I want to tell you to buy a product with a high sales ranking. Also, I don't know if I'm just not using it properly, but I can't even fit a few dishes and stuff in it. And the installer did... I ran it on the standard setting for a full 65 minutes, and even though the cycle clearly includes drying, the clothes didn't dry at all and were soaking wet. Also, since there is no separate drying function, I'm wondering if I need to run the sterilization drying cycle again, or if this thing is even meant to be used for. And it would have been nice if they had included at least a small sample of detergent. Well, it's just... disappointing in many ways. If this wasn't an installation product, I would want to switch to something else, but I can't move a unit that's already installed to another location. I bought it thinking there wouldn't be any warranty issues since it was a direct import from Coupang, but the performance itself is the problem before any warranty issues arise. I don't understand the people leaving positive reviews here; do they just have low expectations? Anyway, I'm really conflicted. I even bought a few packets of tablet-type detergent because it was advertised as eco-friendly, but... well, since there is no detergent container. After using it twice on the first day, I was so disappointed that I didn't even put the clothes in the dishwasher. I just hand-washed it and went back to using my old dryer. Hmm. I’ll try using it again, if only to check if mine is defective, and leave an additional review later.

The third top rack was unappreciated at fitst, but now is absolutely necessary for so many small things that normally would have gotten lost in the wash with our previous machines- love it! The auto-sensing tech gets it right every time- we can put dishes in the device right from the table and they sparkle when coming out. Would definitely recommend. Only one small improvement is needed in our eyes- the silverware basket is too small- we saved the basket from our previous machine and added it to the Bosch factory one, the two baskets serve our family's needs perfectly. All in all, a great machine which performs like a champ. 5/5 stars.

Comments (English): [ Good, but could be better ] || ---------------- || Costco's price was unbeatable, but there were some issues regarding this product. A relative had the same make and model dishwasher installed at their house, and they were happy with what they received. A leading product review company also gave high reviews. The dishwasher we received has a different rack system than our relatives. Our relative has fold-in tines to accommodate various size dishes. Ours does not have this feature and we feel that our ancient model was more spacious than this current, larger dishwasher! Speaking of fit, our purchase from Costco advised the exterior dimensions were of a standard width and height, but this model was 1/4” too tall for the opening. Our house was built in 2004 and does not have custom crafted cabinets, and it's not as if it was too old. Luckily I have power tools that I was able to use to cut the opening taller while the friendly and patient delivery/installers waited. The Costco website claimed an electrical receptacle was necessary for installation, but our old dishwasher was hardwired into the house. What is not explained by Costco is that this model comes with two different connectors; one for a pre-existing hardwire system and one for the electrical receptacle system. This model also includes a silverware basket that has eight cubes for vertical placement of silverware on the bottom rack. Two of the cubes have a short wall and silverware may flop out or sideways in the basket. The middle, glassware rack does not hold as many taller glasses as our ancient one. I don't know who uses the top rack for silverware, who is going to take the time and “file” each of the utensil's? We put our ramekins on this shelf, and they 'barely' fit (height-wise). The door of the dishwasher has strong springs that pull the door shut, not allowing air circulation. After the washing cycle is finished, we customarily prop the door open to allow air drying. Now we use something to wedge the door open. Perhaps there is an adjustment, but we haven't found it in the manual. The dishwasher is a lot more quieter than our previous one. The stainless steel finish with tucked handle and “hidden” controls on the top of the door seems to psychologically make the kitchen look bigger. It is very easy to clean the filter. We just wish we could have received the higher end rack system that others have or be able to fit bowls into the lower rack.

We don't use them much though anyway, because you have to remove the top flat drawer to have enough room for bottles anyway. Thus, the drawers come flying out when full of dishes and it's inadvertently been pushed in. Poor installation is a common problem with the outsourcing I've found; and is seen in comments from all the box stores. Even an independent store near by outsources. We'll likely do the install ourselves next time.

The clips for the bottle washers come off too easily, and two have fallen to the floor and burned on the heating element. We don’t use them much though anyway, because you have to remove the top flat drawer to have enough room for bottles anyway. We also had trouble with install. 5x, and 2 separate installers were unable to secure the dishwasher securely. It pushes in at the bottom, because they only attached it to the cabinets at the top. Thus, the drawers come flying out when full of dishes and it’s inadvertently been pushed in. Poor installation is a common problem with the outsourcing I’ve found; and is seen in comments from all the box stores. Even an independent store near by outsources. We’ll likely do the install ourselves next time.

Sentence (English): When I first purchased this dishwasher in late 2022, I was pretty happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Decent wash; no support when it fails ] || ---------------- || When I first purchased this dishwasher in late 2022, I was pretty happy with it. It did a decent job of cleaning even with our extremely hard water. However, late in 2024 it started failing. Over the course of a month or so, the groaning noises grew louder and eventually it became clear that the motor was failing. When opening the unit while it was running, you'd see water dribbling from the arms and no movement. No problem, right? They advertise a 10 year warranty on the motor. There's huge sticker to that effect right on the front.Wrong. When contacting support, they will try to force a flat rate repair of 349 plus tax on you (so a little over 400 bucks in my case). Whether the motor has failed or some other component doesn't matter. It's the same cost. Which means the warranty on this key part of the system is basically useless because they will get their money from you no matter what. I'm not mad at a failure - systems fail. And I rolled the dice by not purchasing an extended warranty of some sort. And if something else, say the control board, failed I would not be angry about it. But since it's clear that the failed component is something they explicitly advertise on to convince you that this unit is super reliable, I have to ask myself if this isn't false advertising. How does Home Depot feel about this?

The Media Auto Door Open Dishwasher for 6 people comes in two colors: ivory and white. I chose ivory because my kitchen has wood added to it. It’s not a flashy color, so it blends in well without any sense of incongruity. There’s a separate detergent compartment, so you can put both tablet and liquid detergent. I bought a detergent that contains all three: rinse, salt, and detergent right from Coupang. (It has a slight lemon scent and is refreshing, so the scent is good after washing the dishes.) You can put in rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates, and the most convenient thing is that you can easily move the spoon holder. If the spoon holder is fixed, it would have been difficult to put in dishes depending on the size, but I think they thought this part through well (I’m so grateful that they understand the feelings of housewives). Since it has an automatic door opening function, the door opens by two finger joints with about 3 minutes left. The dishwasher opens 90 degrees, but it's good to open it slightly to release the hot air! Instead of drilling into the sink top, the drain hose was pulled out to the sink without a hole. It was neatly finished by fixing it with a rubber packing. The noise is not as loud as I thought. I was worried that it would be loud because it's for 6 people, but it felt like white noise. (This is the level that a person who is not sensitive to noise can feel.) Since it's Wi-Fi enabled, you can control it by connecting it to your phone if you install the app. You can do it in the room, and if you start it while you're out for a while, you can check it without worry because it'll alarm you when it's done. It says it's for 6 people, but after putting dishes in it and using it, I thought it would be perfect for a family of 2-3. You have to put pots and frying pans in it. Media Countertop App-linked Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher for 6 People # Reason for Purchase We are a family of 4, but we only eat simple breakfasts and simple dinners at home~ In other words, we eat, but the amount of dishes to wash is ambiguous enough to use a large-capacity dishwasher, so I just wash the dishes right away because the large-capacity dishwasher at home is inconvenient when guests come over or I have to collect the dishes, but it's actually quite annoying. I always thought it would be perfect if I had something small, but I got to use the Media Countertop App-linked Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher for 6 People through the Coupang Experience Group. # Delivery and Installation This product was available for next-day delivery and installation through Rocket Delivery, but I requested a designated delivery because I was away on a trip. The technician called me on the scheduled date, and he was kind, fast, and thorough~ He was a very versatile technician who installed the pretty dishwasher~ I had a lot of questions, so I asked about this and that, and he showed me the accessories one by one and explained them to me, so I was grateful. # Design I like the white color and the handle. It's neat because it has wood points~ It doesn't mess up the interior at all even if you put it on the sink shelf instead of built-in, which is the part I was most impressed with when I received it! When you look toward the kitchen, it feels brighter! Also, it's not a button type but a touch type, so it doesn't feel messy~ Even when I use it, only the letters I use appear, so it's neater! # Performance - I tried washing it with the standard because they said it's the most used~ The technician also said that it can be washed as it is, but he told me that larvae are important for long-term, healthy use, and I also prefer to wash it without residue by larvae! I washed the amount shown in the picture, and I started washing it while it was oily and slippery~~ It was washed cleanly and squeaky clean, and the deep tumbler wasn't washed well, so I put it back in and tried to do a quick wash, but the washing wasn't smooth because there was a curve at the entrance! I don't think the curved part will work based on the dishwasher principle~ I recommend washing the tumbler separately! ^^ #Noise The machine is not very noisy~ The sound of water is quite loud, but I think that's to be expected. I uploaded a video so that you can understand the sound~^^ #Automatic door opening function The dishwasher does not have a drying function~ However, the door opens automatically after washing and allows natural drying. I think it's a big advantage^^ The door opens as much as you can see in the picture~^^ #Overall If you need to repurchase a 6-person dishwasher or recommend it to a friend, I highly recommend it~ Dishwashers are expensive~ Even for 6 people, the price is a burden, but it is cheaper than other dishwashers, and above all, Coupang guarantees after-sales service, so there's little reason not to buy it! I'll use it well.

I always thought it would be perfect if I had something small, but I got to use the Media Countertop App-linked Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher for 6 People through the Coupang Experience Group. # Delivery and Installation This product was available for next-day delivery and installation through Rocket Delivery, but I requested a designated delivery because I was away on a trip. The technician called me on the scheduled date, and he was kind, fast, and thorough~ He was a very versatile technician who installed the pretty dishwasher~ I had a lot of questions, so I asked about this and that, and he showed me the accessories one by one and explained them to me, so I was grateful. # Design I like the white color and the handle. It's neat because it has wood points~ It doesn't mess up the interior at all even if you put it on the sink shelf instead of built-in, which is the part I was most impressed with when I received it! When you look toward the kitchen, it feels brighter! Also, it's not a button type but a touch type, so it doesn't feel messy~ Even when I use it, only the letters I use appear, so it's neater! # Performance - I tried washing it with the standard because they said it's the most used~ The technician also said that it can be washed as it is, but he told me that larvae are important for long-term, healthy use, and I also prefer to wash it without residue by larvae! I'll use it well.

Media Countertop App-linked Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher for 6 People # Reason for Purchase We are a family of 4, but we only eat simple breakfasts and simple dinners at home~ In other words, we eat, but the amount of dishes to wash is ambiguous enough to use a large-capacity dishwasher, so I just wash the dishes right away because the large-capacity dishwasher at home is inconvenient when guests come over or I have to collect the dishes, but it's actually quite annoying. I always thought it would be perfect if I had something small, but I got to use the Media Countertop App-linked Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher for 6 People through the Coupang Experience Group. # Delivery and Installation This product was available for next-day delivery and installation through Rocket Delivery, but I requested a designated delivery because I was away on a trip. The technician called me on the scheduled date, and he was kind, fast, and thorough~ He was a very versatile technician who installed the pretty dishwasher~ I had a lot of questions, so I asked about this and that, and he showed me the accessories one by one and explained them to me, so I was grateful. # Design I like the white color and the handle. It's neat because it has wood points~ It doesn't mess up the interior at all even if you put it on the sink shelf instead of built-in, which is the part I was most impressed with when I received it! When you look toward the kitchen, it feels brighter! Also, it's not a button type but a touch type, so it doesn't feel messy~ Even when I use it, only the letters I use appear, so it's neater! # Performance - I tried washing it with the standard because they said it's the most used~ The technician also said that it can be washed as it is, but he told me that larvae are important for long-term, healthy use, and I also prefer to wash it without residue by larvae! I washed the amount shown in the picture, and I started washing it while it was oily and slippery~~ It was washed cleanly and squeaky clean, and the deep tumbler wasn't washed well, so I put it back in and tried to do a quick wash, but the washing wasn't smooth because there was a curve at the entrance! I don't think the curved part will work based on the dishwasher principle~ I recommend washing the tumbler separately! ^^ #Noise The machine is not very noisy~ The sound of water is quite loud, but I think that's to be expected. I uploaded a video so that you can understand the sound~^^ #Automatic door opening function The dishwasher does not have a drying function~ However, the door opens automatically after washing and allows natural drying. I think it's a big advantage^^ The door opens as much as you can see in the picture~^^ #Overall If you need to repurchase a 6-person dishwasher or recommend it to a friend, I highly recommend it~ Dishwashers are expensive~ Even for 6 people, the price is a burden, but it is cheaper than other dishwashers, and above all, Coupang guarantees after-sales service, so there's little reason not to buy it! I'll use it well.

Sentence (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review.
Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review. Product basic information. Media 6-person dishwasher with automatic door opening and UV lamp. Color: White, Model name: (MDWMT0601W-WIN-KR). Window design. Free A/S period. 2-year free repairs available through Coupang Customer Service. Friendly and fast delivery. I paid with Coupang Rocket Delivery, and the technician came and installed it the next day, Sunday. I was satisfied with the fast delivery and installation in one day, and the technician was very friendly. Window design. I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. I decided to go with this one because I thought I would use it for a long time once I bought it, and after discussing it with my husband, I decided. Reasonable price. It turned out that various large companies were selling dishwashers manufactured by Media. They were selling them at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs. Knowing that, I wondered if it was really necessary to buy it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried running the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by how quiet it was. Since it's the type that you use on top of the sink, I expected it to be quite noisy. By my standards, it's really quiet. It's perfect for a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. I used it and was very satisfied with the automatic door opening function because I didn't have to wait for the dishwasher to finish and then manually open the door. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of Jayeonpong dishwasher-specific liquid detergent has good reviews for its three-fold enhanced cleaning power, in addition to regular dishes. It has a lemony scent that leaves no residue, and it smells good. It's also reasonably priced, so I plan to continue using it. The only downside is that this model doesn't have hot air drying. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! To improve your quality of life, I highly recommend the Media Dishwasher!

I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. I used it and was very satisfied with the automatic door opening function because I didn't have to wait for the dishwasher to finish and then manually open the door. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review. Product basic information. Media 6-person dishwasher with automatic door opening and UV lamp. I paid with Coupang Rocket Delivery, and the technician came and installed it the next day, Sunday. I was satisfied with the fast delivery and installation in one day, and the technician was very friendly. Window design. I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. I decided to go with this one because I thought I would use it for a long time once I bought it, and after discussing it with my husband, I decided. Reasonable price. It turned out that various large companies were selling dishwashers manufactured by Media. They were selling them at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs. Knowing that, I wondered if it was really necessary to buy it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried running the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by how quiet it was. Since it's the type that you use on top of the sink, I expected it to be quite noisy. By my standards, it's really quiet. It's perfect for a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. I used it and was very satisfied with the automatic door opening function because I didn't have to wait for the dishwasher to finish and then manually open the door. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of Jayeonpong dishwasher-specific liquid detergent has good reviews for its three-fold enhanced cleaning power, in addition to regular dishes. It has a lemony scent that leaves no residue, and it smells good. It's also reasonably priced, so I plan to continue using it. The only downside is that this model doesn't have hot air drying. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! To improve your quality of life, I highly recommend the Media Dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I was satisfied with the fast delivery and installation in one day, and the technician was very friendly.
Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review. Product basic information. Media 6-person dishwasher with automatic door opening and UV lamp. Color: White, Model name: (MDWMT0601W-WIN-KR). Window design. Free A/S period. 2-year free repairs available through Coupang Customer Service. Friendly and fast delivery. I paid with Coupang Rocket Delivery, and the technician came and installed it the next day, Sunday. I was satisfied with the fast delivery and installation in one day, and the technician was very friendly. Window design. I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. I decided to go with this one because I thought I would use it for a long time once I bought it, and after discussing it with my husband, I decided. Reasonable price. It turned out that various large companies were selling dishwashers manufactured by Media. They were selling them at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs. Knowing that, I wondered if it was really necessary to buy it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried running the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by how quiet it was. Since it's the type that you use on top of the sink, I expected it to be quite noisy. By my standards, it's really quiet. It's perfect for a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. I used it and was very satisfied with the automatic door opening function because I didn't have to wait for the dishwasher to finish and then manually open the door. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of Jayeonpong dishwasher-specific liquid detergent has good reviews for its three-fold enhanced cleaning power, in addition to regular dishes. It has a lemony scent that leaves no residue, and it smells good. It's also reasonably priced, so I plan to continue using it. The only downside is that this model doesn't have hot air drying. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! To improve your quality of life, I highly recommend the Media Dishwasher!

Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review. Product basic information. Media 6-person dishwasher with automatic door opening and UV lamp. I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. I decided to go with this one because I thought I would use it for a long time once I bought it, and after discussing it with my husband, I decided. Reasonable price. It turned out that various large companies were selling dishwashers manufactured by Media. They were selling them at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs. Knowing that, I wondered if it was really necessary to buy it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried running the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by how quiet it was. Since it's the type that you use on top of the sink, I expected it to be quite noisy. By my standards, it's really quiet. It's perfect for a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. I used it and was very satisfied with the automatic door opening function because I didn't have to wait for the dishwasher to finish and then manually open the door. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of Jayeonpong dishwasher-specific liquid detergent has good reviews for its three-fold enhanced cleaning power, in addition to regular dishes. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! To improve your quality of life, I highly recommend the Media Dishwasher!

So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review. Product basic information. Media 6-person dishwasher with automatic door opening and UV lamp. I paid with Coupang Rocket Delivery, and the technician came and installed it the next day, Sunday. I was satisfied with the fast delivery and installation in one day, and the technician was very friendly. Window design. I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. I decided to go with this one because I thought I would use it for a long time once I bought it, and after discussing it with my husband, I decided. Reasonable price. It turned out that various large companies were selling dishwashers manufactured by Media. They were selling them at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs. Knowing that, I wondered if it was really necessary to buy it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried running the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by how quiet it was. Since it's the type that you use on top of the sink, I expected it to be quite noisy. By my standards, it's really quiet. It's perfect for a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. I used it and was very satisfied with the automatic door opening function because I didn't have to wait for the dishwasher to finish and then manually open the door. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of Jayeonpong dishwasher-specific liquid detergent has good reviews for its three-fold enhanced cleaning power, in addition to regular dishes. It has a lemony scent that leaves no residue, and it smells good. It's also reasonably priced, so I plan to continue using it. The only downside is that this model doesn't have hot air drying. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! To improve your quality of life, I highly recommend the Media Dishwasher!

Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review. Product basic information. Media 6-person dishwasher with automatic door opening and UV lamp. I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I ultimately decided on the window type. The reason was that it had a more open feel, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function. The price difference was only about 40,000 won compared to the basic design model. I decided to go with this one because I thought I would use it for a long time once I bought it, and after discussing it with my husband, I decided. Reasonable price. It turned out that various large companies were selling dishwashers manufactured by Media. They were selling them at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs. Knowing that, I wondered if it was really necessary to buy it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried running the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by how quiet it was. Since it's the type that you use on top of the sink, I expected it to be quite noisy. By my standards, it's really quiet. It's perfect for a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience. The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher was because I'm seven months pregnant, and now I can't stand still without any pain in my back, hips, stomach, or knees due to the weight of my belly. So, I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as washing dishes. I've been using it and it's great because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I'm tired. Also, we'll be a family of three soon after the baby is born, and since we mostly eat home-cooked meals rather than eating out, I could see how much better my quality of life would be if the dishwasher cleaned the dishes and bottles more thoroughly than I could. I used it and was very satisfied with the automatic door opening function because I didn't have to wait for the dishwasher to finish and then manually open the door. The glass cups looked even clearer than the ones I washed myself! I cleaned the dishes thoroughly, top, middle, and bottom, three times, so if you play Tetris well, there's no place that's not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of Jayeonpong dishwasher-specific liquid detergent has good reviews for its three-fold enhanced cleaning power, in addition to regular dishes. But since most six-person dishwashers do, I understand and can overlook it. The dishwasher intelligently uses the auto-open feature to release heat, and after a while, the dishes dry. I didn't have to dry them every time I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so I don't have to worry. This was a big plus, and it played a part in my decision. This is my honest review of a product I purchased with my own money. If it helped you make a purchase, please let me know. Please press and hold! Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review. Product basic information. Media 6-person dishwasher with automatic door opening and UV lamp.
