Comments (English): [ I am extremely satisfied with the express installation and delivery within just one day of purchase. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase (I'm being completely honest, I bought this with my own money). Dishwashers are a must-have item for everyone these days; those who haven't used one might not know, but for those who have, it's a whole new world. So, to make life a little easier, I brought in a "dishwasher lady." Since I bought it with my own money, I wanted to be careful. I debated between the 8-place, 12-place, and 14-place models available on the market. However, given my personality—I can't stand seeing dishes pile up—I'd rather run it one more time than do it all at once. (I'm such a fuss!) I settled on the 6-place model. I watched YouTube and Naver blogs, and I spent two whole days researching before making a decision. Although Coupang offers a 2-year warranty, it was honestly an unfamiliar brand to me. To be cautious, I looked up a lot of reviews before buying. I looked at L, Sam, Coupang, Mi, S... and I decided on this one. Someone once told me that as long as the dishwashing function works well, the brand doesn't really matter. So, I decided on a product that is a bit cheaper but offers great value for money. Advantages of the Midea Dishwasher: 1. It has a 2-tier rack inside that separates, allowing large pots and bulky dishes to fit inside. 2. Its compact size allows for installation even in narrow spaces. 3. It can be installed in the kitchen without drilling holes. 4. It adds a great touch to your interior decor. 5. It saves water. Based on my criteria, I hesitated a lot because it doesn't have UV sterilization or hot air drying. While UV sterilization is nice to have, I didn't find it that great when I used a baby bottle sterilizer. Also, since my baby is currently 6 years old, I felt it wouldn't be necessary, so I passed on it. People said the hot air drying feature is a game changer and is great to have, but opinions are divided, so I passed on that too. I saw reviews saying it's basically drying with a folding dryer. It has an automatic door opening function, so I passed on that as well. If I were to weigh every single factor and buy one that perfectly suits my taste, there would be no end to the choices and the price would go up. I had a benchmark of exactly around the 400,000 won mark. That is why I chose it. It has automatic door opening and allows you to put items in the middle, so... well, it's better than washing dishes by hand. I set the price at 400,000 won and got drill-free installation, so I'm very satisfied in my own way. For those of you considering a dishwasher, I recommend getting one right away. I used to think, "It would be convenient to have, but how much convenience could I really make?" But it is definitely convenient and cleans thoroughly. I think all dishwashers are pretty much the same. I am a family of three who cooks all our meals at home; it is sufficient for one baby and two adults. I hope my review is helpful~~~. Additional review after Day 1 use: The basic function takes about 75 minutes. You cannot use plastic food container lids (the rubber ones). The cutlery holder is a bit small, but it fits perfectly with my baby's (6-year-old) spoons and forks. For the adults, I just put them inside the dishwasher and ran it. When I removed the top tray, a large wok fits in. Hmm. Also, I was surprised by how much fits in it, much more than I expected. Hot air drying? I heard it was good to have that feature, so I agonized over it for a while before finally buying this one. Even on the basic 75-minute dishwashing function, the door opens automatically. There is a little moisture, but I just wiped it lightly with a dry dishcloth or paper towel. If it’s not urgent, I think it will dry pretty well if I just leave the door a little open. Having never used one before, this is a whole new world. I saw an LG washing machine at another house today, and it wasn't anything special. I heard you only need to do a drum wash about once a month, so I bought a Pringles and plan to do that. I agonized over buying it, but it really is a whole new world that I bought with my own money. Should I say I have more time? For those of you who are debating, the 6-person capacity is sufficient for a family of three. If you gather all the dishes from the day in one go in the evening, it’s enough. Oh! For those wondering about the noise... it’s not unpleasant; it’s about the sound of water filling up in a washing machine. It’s quieter than a vacuum cleaner, quieter than inter-floor noise, and quieter than a baby crying. It’s just about the same level as the water coming out when you’re washing dishes. I'm satisfied. My aunt is the best!

Comments (English): Purchased with my own money / Midea 6-Place Dishwasher Review. Product Basic Information. Midea Automatic Door Opening UV Lamp Dishwasher 6-Place. Color: White. Model Name: (MDWMT0601W-WIN-KR). Window-type Design. Warranty Period. 2 years of free repairs available through the Coupang Customer Center. Friendly + Fast Delivery. First of all, I paid via Coupang Rocket Delivery, and the technician came directly to my house the very next day, Sunday, to install it. I was satisfied with the fast delivery and installation within just one day, and the technician was also incredibly friendly. Window Design. I was originally debating between the standard Midea dishwasher design and the window-type model, but I finally decided on the window model. The reason was that it offers a sense of openness, has a prettier design, and includes a UV sterilization function. The price difference compared to the standard model was only about 40,000 won. Since we plan to use it for a long time once we buy it, I decided to go with this one. After discussing it with my husband, we made up our minds. Reasonable Price. It turned out that the dishwasher product manufactured by Midea... I found out that various major corporations were selling similar products. Knowing that they were selling them at a higher price with just relabeled labels and slightly different designs, I wondered if it was really necessary to pay more. So I searched for "Medium" and found out that Coupang officially imports them, offering a 2-year free warranty, so I decided to purchase it. Low noise... When I operated the dishwasher, the sound it made was quieter than I expected. Honestly, I was surprised by the low noise level. Since it sits on the countertop, I expected a lot of noise. By my standards, the sound was really subtle. It is perfectly usable even in a home with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience... The decisive reason I bought a dishwasher was that, as a 7-month pregnant woman, I now feel pain everywhere—my lower back, pelvis, stomach, knees, etc.—even when I am just sitting still due to the weight of my belly. So, I purchased it to reduce the time spent on housework, such as doing the dishes while standing. After using it, I find it wonderful that I can do other things or take a break when I get tired during the time I would otherwise spend washing dishes. With the baby arriving soon, we will become a family of three. Since we mainly eat home-cooked meals rather than dining out, I could clearly see my quality of life improve if the dishwasher washed our dishes and bottles even more thoroughly than I could. After using it, I found the automatic door opening feature very convenient and satisfying; thanks to it, I didn't have to wait for the wash to finish just to open the door manually. It was like magic—glass cups looked even clearer than when I washed them myself! Since it cleans every nook and cranny with a triple-layer system (top, middle, and bottom), if you pack the dishes well, there are no spots left unwashed, and they come out spotlessly clean. I searched on Coupang, bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance, and poured it in. The latest version of the Jayeonpong dishwasher-specific liquid detergent has great reviews because it can wash baby bottles in addition to regular dishes, and its cleaning power is three times more upgraded. It leaves no residue, smells nice with a lemon scent, and is reasonably priced, so I plan to keep using it. The only downside is just one thing: this model does not have a hot air drying function. But since most 6-place setting dishwashers are like that, I guess I'll just accept it and move on. The dishwasher intelligently releases heat using the automatic door opening function, and the dishes dry after a while anyway. I never had to dry each dish individually even when washing them by hand. Also, this product has a stainless steel top, so I have no worries. The decisive reason I bought a dishwasher was that, as a 7-month pregnant woman, I now feel pain everywhere—my lower back, pelvis, stomach, knees, etc.—even when I am just sitting still due to the weight of my belly. So, I purchased it to reduce the time spent on housework, such as doing the dishes while standing. After using it, I find it wonderful that I can do other things or take a break when I get tired during the time I would otherwise spend washing dishes. With the baby arriving soon, we will become a family of three. Since we mainly eat home-cooked meals rather than dining out, I could clearly see my quality of life improve if the dishwasher washed our dishes and bottles even more thoroughly than I could. After using it, I found the automatic door opening feature very convenient and satisfying; thanks to it, I didn't have to wait for the wash to finish just to open the door manually. It was like magic—glass cups looked even clearer than when I washed them myself! Since it cleans every nook and cranny with a triple-layer system (top, middle, and bottom), if you pack the dishes well, there are no spots left unwashed, and they come out spotlessly clean. I searched on Coupang, bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance, and poured it in. That was a huge advantage and played a part in my decision. This concludes my honest review of a product I bought with my own money. By my standards, the sound was really subtle. It is perfectly usable even in a home with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience... The decisive reason I bought a dishwasher was that, as a 7-month pregnant woman, I now feel pain everywhere—my lower back, pelvis, stomach, knees, etc.—even when I am just sitting still due to the weight of my belly. So, I purchased it to reduce the time spent on housework, such as doing the dishes while standing. After using it, I find it wonderful that I can do other things or take a break when I get tired during the time I would otherwise spend washing dishes. With the baby arriving soon, we will become a family of three. Since we mainly eat home-cooked meals rather than dining out, I could clearly see my quality of life improve if the dishwasher washed our dishes and bottles even more thoroughly than I could. After using it, I found the automatic door opening feature very convenient and satisfying; thanks to it, I didn't have to wait for the wash to finish just to open the door manually. It was like magic—glass cups looked even clearer than when I washed them myself! Since it cleans every nook and cranny with a triple-layer system (top, middle, and bottom), if you pack the dishes well, there are no spots left unwashed, and they come out spotlessly clean. I searched on Coupang, bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance, and poured it in. I never had to dry each dish individually even when washing them by hand. Also, this product has a stainless steel top, so I have no worries. That was a huge advantage and played a part in my decision. This concludes my honest review of a product I bought with my own money. If this helped you with your purchase decision, please press the "Helpful" button! I highly, highly recommend the Midea dishwasher to improve your quality of life!

When opening the unit while it was running, you'd see water dribbling from the arms and no movement. No problem, right? They advertise a 10 year warranty on the motor. There's huge sticker to that effect right on the front. Wrong. When contacting support, they will try to force a flat rate repair of 349 plus tax on you (so a little over 400 bucks in my case). Whether the motor has failed or some other component doesn't matter. It's the same cost. Which means the warranty on this key part of the system is basically useless because they will get their money from you no matter what. I'm not mad at a failure - systems fail. And I rolled the dice by not purchasing an extended warranty of some sort. And if something else, say the control board, failed I would not be angry about it. But since it's clear that the failed component is something they explicitly advertise on to convince you that this unit is super reliable, I have to ask myself if this isn't false advertising. How does Home Depot feel about this?

Sentence (English): I rarely write reviews, but after dealing with one issue after another with LG products, I felt compelled to share my experience.
Comments (English): [ Frustrating Experience with LG Appliances ] || ---------------- || I rarely write reviews, but after dealing with one issue after another with LG products, I felt compelled to share my experience. We purchased five LG appliances (dishwasher, refrigerator, microwave, washer, and dryer) about three years ago, and it has been a series of disappointments.Starting with the dishwasher—it's been nothing but trouble. It's definitely not quiet, as advertised. We've had to replace several parts over the years, including the motor. It keeps showing a "BE" error message, which indicates excessive bubbles, but no one has been able to provide any real assistance to fix the issue. I don't even know what to do with it at this point.To make matters worse, the other appliances haven't fared much better. We had to replace the microwave entirely, had service calls for the sensor on the dryer, and it's still not working as it should. The washing machine doesn't clean the clothes properly and the spin cycle is always out of balance, so you have to either put very small loads in or you have to keep re-running the spin cycle to get the water out of the clothes.Honestly, I was hoping that purchasing a full set of appliances from one brand would be a good investment, but this has been a major letdown. I've given LG appliances plenty of chances to work properly, but it's been a constant headache. I can't recommend LG after this experience.

Sentence (English): I did a ton of research and this one popped up as a medium priced dishwasher with good function and quality.
Comments (English): [ Had to return it - doesn't wash well ] || ---------------- || I did a ton of research and this one popped up as a medium priced dishwasher with good functionality and quality. I checked the filter after about load 4 and it was clean, so that doesn't seem to be the issue. Ran it both on sensor and normal mode. Didn't seem to matter. I gave it two stars because the smoothness and quality of the racks are better than most dishwashers I tried. Speaking of, we were going to get a Bosch, but the racks on all models were terrible (red flag for the price), and all retailers upped the prices by about $200 on 1/31/25. So, no thanks. We have since ordered the $750 LG LDTH5554S. Hopefully it washes better.

Sentence (English): We bought this 800 series dishwasher in February 2024 to replace a Kitchenaid model that was awful in cleaning dishes.
Comments (English): [ Awesome dishwasher - Need tweaks for ideal results ] || ---------------- || We bought this 800 series dishwasher in February 2024 to replace a Kitchenaid model that was awful in cleaning dishes.We love this Bosch. I would have given 5*, but took a star out because it requires some tweaks to get the most ideal performance.We love the quiet performance, the dishes come out clean and dry every time. We also got rid of the dreaded "Bosch fish smell" on dishes! To get this performance consistently, I recommend the following:1. Use a rinse agent. Period. It does not matter what detergent you use, but don't skimp on the rinse agent. You need that for optimal drying and spotless dishes just like in any Bosch dishwasher that does not have a dryer element.2. Download the Home Connect APP. There are many features including remote start, decoding symbols on the door etc. that are available only through the app3, Use the top rack. Like many, I also complained about the cutlery basket taking up too much space. I finally discovered that I can place all the spoons & forks along with flat utensil on the top tray for spotless cleaning and allowing the bottom tray for more plates. See attached photo. We had 60+ spoons, forks and knives after our thanksgiving dinner! 4. One month after our new dishwasher was installed, we hit the fishy odor phenomenon. We had this issue with our previous Bosch 15 years ago as well, which we could not overcome despite constant filter cleaning and using dishwasher cleaner. I read that placing a piece of copper tubing helps get rid of this issue. I placed one in the middle rack (see attached picture) skeptically and in the 11 months after placing that, we have not had a single fish odor episode! My go to wash cycle is Auto with the power control spray arm turned on front and back and sanitize + crystal dry. It takes 3 hrs and 5 minutes for sparkly clean, fresh smelling and warm & dry dishes. every single time.I wish this dishwasher had an express 30 minute short cycle for a quick wash & rinse before a dinner party.Overall, a great machine, especially after these tweaks.

Sentence (English): I recently moved into a condo where the appliances were already installed.
Comments (English): [ It Just OK - ] || ---------------- || I recently moved into a condo where the appliances were already installed. Sure enough, within a few months the Dishwasher that was there died. My brother had recently purchased a Bosch dishwasher and suggested I do the same. The dishwasher I needed had to be a black finish to match the other appliances. Honestly, I was somewaht disappointed with the one I received. It has a touch pad for programming. My brothers dishwasher has push button details and is much easier to use. The top utility rack is a bit of a pain because it's always dripping wet when the washer finishes its cycle. As far as quiet, it's fairly quiet but I can still hear it running. The dishwasher I had in my previous house was silent, and much easier to program then this one. Al in all if I had it to do over again I would choose either a different model or perhaps a different brand.

The installer called to schedule the installation on a weekday, but he said it had to be done before 6 PM, so I postponed it to Saturday and asked about the additional cost. Sentence (English): Received as a gift for Christmas from my parents to replace my broken 10 yr old dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Dishes never so clean as now ] || ---------------- || Received as a gift for Christmas from my parents to replace my broken 10 yr old dishwasher. They picked it out so I was unsure what I was getting but this dishwasher has exceeded my expectations. Beautiful stainless steel, inside and out. So much quieter than my previous dishwashers. And it cleans amazingly well. My dishes never looked this sparkling clean coming out of the other dishwashers! The only negatives I have to say about this Maytag are both pretty minor. The first is the wash cycle is very long over 2 and a half hours including the drying cycle but I just set it to run while we're asleep (we can't hear it) or while we're gone for the day at work. The second minor issue is how low to the ground the bottom rack is when you pull it out to load and unload dishes. It sits maybe six inches at most from the floor which could be potentially problematic some with mobility issues. Luckily it's not an issue for us. The positive to the bottom rack being so low is there is significantly more clearance for larger dishes, pans, casseroles, cutting boards, etc. I can fit items in the Maytag that I couldn't fit in my other dishwashers. So the trade off is well worth it.

Sentence (English): This review is about Lowe's complete incompetence in dealing with damaged products and related re-delivery and install of a replacement.
Comments (English): [ Product OK - Delivery and Install a Nightmare ] || ---------------- || This review is about Lowe's complete incompetence in dealing with damaged products and related re-delivery and install of a replacement. If I could, I'd give Lowe's a ZERO or negative star review. We purchased this Kitchen Aid dishwasher on 12/3/24, along with the Lowe's delivery and installation package. We were given an install date of 1/4/25, quite a long period, but given the holiday time upcoming and the usual supply chain issues these days, we were OK with it. On January 4, 2025, the third party installer showed up, but he declined to install the machine because he found major damage to it when he opened the box in his truck. We thanked him for his professionalism and customer care. But, that's when the ClusterF began. Long story short, Lowe's took nearly two weeks to re-order the same model, plus for some reason unilaterally cancelled and credited to my credit card the delivery/installation package we had purchased originally (delaying the new install even more), and made me re-buy the delivery/install package. That install package cancellation totally screwed up the new install date even more with Lowe's third party installer. I had to go back into the Lowe's store to deal with this mess, since nobody in-store at Lowe's Applicance answered the phone in several calls, and nobody else there on the phone could deal with it. The Appliance department clerks when I got there were clueless on how to deal with this mess, took an hour or more to figure it out. They even left me sitting at the desk by myself for 10 minutes – just leaving me there without saying a word to me as they left! Then, they asked me 3 times as I sat there at the customer desk if I “still wanted” the delivery/install package, after I told them “YES, of course I want it – YOU cancelled it, not ME”. They had no clue how/why Lowe's cancelled it. More important, it's as if Lowe's and its third party installer are on different planets -- nobody at either place could give me a consistent answer and their software must not talk to each other – both are incapable of properly handling this situation. BTW, the final installer is actually a local 4th party installer who contracts with the 3rd party corporate installer, another layer of madness. At one point, I was getting email and texts from Lowe's and the 3rd party installer that were completely contradictory on the new install date. I even kept getting more email from Lowe's demanding I go to the store to pick up the new machine myself ! The new dishwasher actually sat back in the Lowe's store's warehouse section for at least a week before ultimate delivery. To top it off, I was supposed to get a call the night before the new install date (finally) on the delivery time window the next day. NEVER got a call, text or email from the third party installer on the delivery window—OF COURSE. I had to call myself that next morning to the 3rd party installer (horrible phone tree) to get the install time window, or more to the point, was it actually going to happen. The rep's response to my question why I never got a call from his outfit was basically "huh? " I won't even get into how this has required even more correspondence and trouble regarding the begin date of the Lowe's 3-year product extended warranty we originally bought. The amount of time and frustration I spent dealing with this nightmare has been unbelievable. The dishwasher was finally installed on Jan. 30, 2025 -- almost TWO MONTHS after purchase. We've run it once, so far, so good. Luckily, our old DW still worked in the 2 months of and phone tree/emails/texts/incompetence hell. UPSHOT: If you can avoid it, do NOT change the install date originally given to you by Lowe's on a dishwasher, or any other appliance for that matter. IF your product is damaged on delivery and cannot be installed, may God be with you getting re-delivery of a replacement by LOWE's and their 9 circles of hell of incompetent customer services. In that case, I suggest you just CANCEL your order, get a refund, and GO SOMEWHERE ELSE.

Like new automobiles, there is a lot of new tech in appliances; in this case, rinse-aid additive, salt to combat hard water, and machine-cleaning pellets. However, I threw away the water-hardness test strip (the one thing the installer left) and had to figure that out with a hardware store trip and some phone calls. Packing dishes is another learning curve, but this machine holds much more than its predecessor. Old machine had a 40-minute wash/dry cycle; new machine is 2:15 if you use the recommended "Auto" cycle; 2:10 in "Normal"; 1-hour in Quick. Sentence (English): I recently moved into a condo where the appliances were already installed.

As far as quiet, it's fairly quiet but I can still hear it running. The dishwasher I had in my previous house was silent, and much easier to program then this one. All in all, if I had it to do over again I would choose either a different model or perhaps a different brand.

Sentence (English): I have been using a dishwasher since I got married.
Comments (English): [ Review of the 4th dishwasher purchased in 20 years of living ] || ---------------- || I have been using a dishwasher since I got married. I used to use the dishwasher as a given, but when it broke down and I couldn't use it for a couple of months, I really felt the need for a dishwasher. It was a humid summer, and the dishes I washed the night before were still there the next morning, so I thought it couldn't be helped and quickly bought a new one. I was worried about bacteria in the hot and humid summer water stains. But I don't have the diligence to wipe the water off and put the dishes away right after washing them. * Reason for buying this model. It's not a new house or remodeling, so I didn't want to buy expensive new products, and I looked for something that was faithful to the basic functions and was inexpensive. Since it washes and dries at high temperatures up to 70-80 degrees, I didn't really need the steam function, and I've been using the spoon rack on the top of the 3-tier shelf as a spoon holder, so I'll pass~ The most important thing was the auto-open function! The one I had before was old (used for 7 years) so the automatic door opening didn't work, so when the dishwasher was done sounding, I'd come out on purpose even if I was in my room, or ask the family member closest to the kitchen to open the door for me. So I looked for an inexpensive one based on these criteria and ended up buying this model. * After using it for a few days, here's what I found disappointing: There's no pause button. The old one was from SK, and even though it's a 7-year-old model, it has a pause button, but the LG one doesn't. I think the latest model has it. If you want to pause it, you can open the door slightly and it will stop working. This is called the pause function. It's not that there's no pause function, but since the old one doesn't have the button that I had, it's a bit difficult to get used to. * If I buy it again next time, I definitely want a feature like this! - 3-tier shelf I didn't think it was important when I bought it this time, but since I have a lot of family members and a lot of dishes come out, the space taken up by the cutlery holder (much bigger than the one I used before) feels quite large. It's a bit disappointing that a few more dishes could have fit without the cutlery holder - Individual drying function Sometimes I just want to dry a bowl of washed dishes, but that function wasn't there when I bought the dishwasher before. I guess the latest expensive models have it these days. * Final review This time, I bought this product because the low price was my purchasing criteria, and I'm satisfied with it because it has all the basic functions for a price in the early 600,000 won range and I'm using it well.

I guess the latest expensive models have it these days. * Final review This time, I bought this product because the low price was my purchasing criteria, and I'm satisfied with it because it has all the basic functions for a price in the early 600,000 won range and I'm using it well.

I guess the latest expensive models have it these days. * Final review This time, I bought this product because the low price was my purchasing criteria, and I'm satisfied with it because it has all the basic functions for a price in the early 600,000 won range and I'm using it well.

Overall, we are very happy with the KitchenAid, and just hope that it serves us as well as our old washer did.

Sentence (English): I really like my new Whirlpool dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I'm pleased with my dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I really like my new Whirlpool dishwasher. It fits perfectly into the space where my old dishwasher was. Installation was straightforward; my husband installed it without any issues as he is handy with that sort of thing. I've used it a couple of times now, and while I have mostly positive things to say, there are a couple of features that I dislike.First, the buttons are located on top of the dishwasher, which can be a challenge for older individuals. They are under the ledge of the counter, making it difficult to see the buttons without a flashlight or reading glasses. I think they should reconsider this design and make the buttons more accessible, as I personally prefer them on the outside of the machine.Another thing I don't like is that the Whirlpool logo is not on the front of the dishwasher. All my other Whirlpool appliances, including the refrigerator, microwave, and range, have the brand logo prominently displayed, but the dishwasher does not. I wish it had that on there for a more cohesive look.On the positive side, I absolutely love the third drying rack at the top for utensils. It's a standout feature, and I appreciate how the layout of the racks allows for better organization of dishes compared to my old machine. I also love that it's a brand new appliance; it works well and matches my other recent Whirlpool purchases. Overall, I'm quite pleased with the dishwasher and give it four stars out of five.

Comments (English): [ Holy Quiet, Batman!  ] || ---------------- || Our Bosch dishwasher does more than just get 'em clean. First of all, the very top rack is adjustable and does a great job with the flatware we've placed there. The adjustability allows for slightly loarger flatware. We tilt it for two reasons: one, to allow larger implemtnts in the first rack below, and two, to keep water fro accruing on items that we put in the second rack. Of course it does a great job cleaning, but what I didn't expect was how quiet it is. Honestly, more that once I had to stop, lean down so my ear was closer, and listen to make sure it was running! lastly, we enjoy the app and beign able to start it without having to be home and the alert to know that it has completed its task. Bottom line? Great machine that delivers on what it says it can do.

Sentence (English): I bought this to replace an earlier Bosch that held up for over 15 years of almost daily use.
Comments (English): [ Pretty good ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace an earlier Bosch that held up for over 15 years of almost daily use. The newer model is certainly quiet and does a fine job of washing -- no complaints there. However, both the interior and exterior feel noticably flimsier than my previous model -- the front deflects pretty noticably when I clean it, and the racks don't feel as solid, although I do like the third rack for silverware. My only other note would be that it has fewer movable tines than my previous one, which makes it a bit tricky to make room for pots.

Sentence (English): Let's be honest - men and washing dishes are rarely a successful duo.
Comments (English): [ Number 1 ] || ---------------- || Let's be honest - men and washing dishes are rarely a successful duo. And for a long time I was convinced that a dishwasher was a "family" appliance. Until I finally bought one. What has changed? - Mess in the kitchen? No more. Dirty dishes go straight to the sink. No cups in the sink, no plates on the counter. - Washing up after a party? Not my problem. Before, every big dinner ended with a pile of dishes. Now I throw everything in the dishwasher and turn on the program. - Better washing than by hand. You don't have to scrub anything, there are no streaks on the glasses, and the pots look like new. And what about the bills? At first, I was afraid of higher electricity and water consumption, but it quickly turned out that a dishwasher uses much less than washing by hand. I thought it was a gadget for large families. Now I know that it is a device that saves me time, water and nerves. It is absolutely worth it.

Sentence (English): I should have bought it earlier.
Comments (English): [ It's so comfortable ] || ---------------- || I should have bought it earlier. I installed it the day after ordering it, and since my house is a standard size, there was no installation fee and it was installed quickly. Prepare dishwashing detergent in advance before installation. I like the design. It is beige, so it doesn't burn and goes well anywhere. It has a luxurious design. I bought it for 1.06 million won, but when I looked at it, I saw that it was 1.03 million won and 1.01 million won. It's better to put it in your shopping cart and buy it when the price is the lowest. When I compared it with offline stores, there was a difference of 500,000 to 600,000 won. I bought it cheaply. It's spacious for 12 people, so I put breakfast, lunch, and dinner together at night. I just wipe it with water once and put it all in the dishwasher. When I open it in the morning, it's all dry and fluffy. I put in any dishes, cups, etc. It has three levels. There are wine glass holders on both sides of the second level, but I don't use them much. I use the steam and hot air dryers usefully. I turn on the steam when I clean oily frying pans. Since it's a hot air dryer model, I always turn on the hot air as well. The dishwasher has an automatic door opening function. There is nothing to worry about when managing it, but you have to clean the filter once a week. If you clean it thoroughly before putting the dishes in, the filter will not get dirty. The good thing about it being linked to the smart app is that it gives an alarm when the rinse is low or the filter is replaced. And you can tell when it is time to wash it all. I don't use the app much, but I still look at it often. Even if it is not an app, the machine itself gives an alarm. The machine is quiet. They say there is a night mode, but it is quiet even if you don't. The night mode makes the drying time longer. If you are going to buy it anyway, I recommend buying it online for a low price with a steam or hot air dryer model. Coupang is cheap. I wonder why I bought it now. It is so convenient that I should have bought it earlier. I recommend it to people around me. ***This is a review written with satisfaction with my own money. Comments (Original): [ 너무 편해요 ] || ---------------- || 진작 살걸 그랬어요. 주문한 다음날 설치했고 저희집은 규격장이라 설치비 없었고 금방 설치 끝났어요. 설치전 식세기세제 미리 준비하세요.  디자인 맘에 들어요. 베이지색이라 틔지도 않고 어디든 어울리죠. 고급진 디자인이예요. 전 106만에 샀는데 저 사고보니 103만, 101만까지도 봤어요ㅜ 장바구니 담아놨다가 최저가 쌀때 사는게 좋아요. 오프라인매장과 비교했더니 50에서 60만원 차이가 나더군요. 싸게 잘 샀습니다.  12인용이라 넉넉하고 아침 점심 저녁 다 모아서 밤에 한꺼번에 돌려요. 그냥 한번 쓱 물로 닦아주고 식세기에 다 넣어요. 아침에 열어보면 보송보송 잘 말라있어요. 전 아무그릇이나 컵 등등 다 넣습니다.  3단이고요. 두번째칸에 양옆으로  와인잔 꽂는 곳 있는데 전 그건 잘 안쓰고요ㅎㅎ스팀,열풍건조 유용하게 씁니다. 기름진 후라이팬 닦을땐 스팀돌려요. 열풍건조 모델이라 열풍도 항상 같이 돌리고요. 식세기 자동으로 문열림기능 있어요.  관리할때 딱히 신경쓸건 없는데 일주일 한번 필터 닦아줘야되요. 그릇돌리기전 깨끗이 애벌세척해서 넣으면 필터도 크게 더럽지않습니다.  스마트앱과 연동되서 좋은점은 린스부족하거나 필터교체시 알람이 떠요. 그리고 통세척 할 시기가 언제인지 알 수 있어요. 앱은 잘 안 쓰긴하는데 그래도 종종 봐요. 앱 아니어도 기계 자체에서도 알람이 뜨긴합니다. 기계소리는 조용해요. 야간모드도 있다던데 굳이 안해도 조용합니다. 야간모드 하면 건조시간 더 길어져요. 이왕 살거면 스팀. 열풍건조모델로 온라인에서 저렴히 사시라 권유드려봅니다. 쿠팡이 저렴해요.  왜 이제 샀나싶어요. 진작 살걸ㅜ 너무 편합니다. 제 주위에도 좋다고 추천하고 있어요  ***내돈내산으로 만족하며 쓴 후기입니다. 이 후기가 도움이 된다면 도움돼요 눌러주세요***

The installation cost was 150,000 won because the sink remodeler was called separately because it was a non-standard cabinet. (I saw in the apartment group chat that Samsung costs 90,000 won for the same cabinet.) First of all, I am a beginner who has never used a dishwasher before! I have used it for about 2 weeks and I am very satisfied. It is very convenient because it does 80% of the work when I do 20%. I recommend it to those who do not wash the dishes right after eating. Those who have a large family and eat a full bowl even after eating once. I think 12-person households are too big for one or two people to eat once or twice, so the dishes do not come out much. I eat two meals a day, so I run it almost every two days, so it is just right for a two-person household that eats home. It is not difficult to use. The technician explained it in detail for more than 10 minutes. I think it was a good decision to buy a model with a three-tier cutlery tray. There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. Since it is a WIFI-enabled model, I connected it to WIFI and linked it to the LG app. There is a lot of information such as the exact usage method of the dishwasher, courses, and number of uses, so I recommend downloading the app. When connected to WIFI, the app notifies you when it is finished. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. First of all, I am so happy that the dishwasher came in. The #1 best purchase since moving is the LG TV, and #2 is the LG dishwasher~ I am recommending it to people around me. The design is also neat and pretty with a matte beige color (+). This is an additional review after using it for 3 months. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

The installation cost was 150,000 won because the sink remodeler was called separately because it was a non-standard cabinet. (I saw in the apartment group chat that Samsung costs 90,000 won for the same cabinet.) First of all, I am a beginner who has never used a dishwasher before! I have used it for about 2 weeks and I am very satisfied. It is very convenient because it does 80% of the work when I do 20%. I recommend it to those who do not wash the dishes right after eating. Those who have a large family and eat a full bowl even after eating once. I think 12-person households are too big for one or two people to eat once or twice, so the dishes do not come out much. I eat two meals a day, so I run it almost every two days, so it is just right for a two-person household that eats home. It is not difficult to use. The technician explained it in detail for more than 10 minutes. I think it was a good decision to buy a model with a three-tier cutlery tray. There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. Since it is a WIFI-enabled model, I connected it to WIFI and linked it to the LG app. There is a lot of information such as the exact usage method of the dishwasher, courses, and number of uses, so I recommend downloading the app. When connected to WIFI, the app notifies you when it is finished. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. First of all, I am so happy that the dishwasher came in. The #1 best purchase since moving is the LG TV, and #2 is the LG dishwasher~ I am recommending it to people around me. The design is also neat and pretty with a matte beige color (+). This is an additional review after using it for 3 months. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

I have used it for about 2 weeks and I am very satisfied. It is very convenient because it does 80% of the work when I do 20%. I recommend it to those who do not wash the dishes right after eating. Those who have a large family and eat a full bowl even after eating once. I think 12-person households are too big for one or two people to eat once or twice, so the dishes do not come out much. I eat two meals a day, so I run it almost every two days, so it is just right for a two-person household that eats home. It is not difficult to use. The technician explained it in detail for more than 10 minutes. I think it was a good decision to buy a model with a three-tier cutlery tray. There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. Since it is a WIFI-enabled model, I connected it to WIFI and linked it to the LG app. There is a lot of information such as the exact usage method of the dishwasher, courses, and number of uses, so I recommend downloading the app. When connected to WIFI, the app notifies you when it is finished. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. First of all, I am so happy that the dishwasher came in. The #1 best purchase since moving is the LG TV, and #2 is the LG dishwasher~ I am recommending it to people around me. The design is also neat and pretty with a matte beige color (+). This is an additional review after using it for 3 months. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

I have used it for about 2 weeks and I am very satisfied. It is very convenient because it does 80% of the work when I do 20%. I recommend it to those who do not wash the dishes right after eating. Those who have a large family and eat a full bowl even after eating once. I think 12-person households are too big for one or two people to eat once or twice, so the dishes do not come out much. I eat two meals a day, so I run it almost every two days, so it is just right for a two-person household that eats home. It is not difficult to use. The technician explained it in detail for more than 10 minutes. I think it was a good decision to buy a model with a three-tier cutlery tray. There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. Since it is a WIFI-enabled model, I connected it to WIFI and linked it to the LG app. There is a lot of information such as the exact usage method of the dishwasher, courses, and number of uses, so I recommend downloading the app. When connected to WIFI, the app notifies you when it is finished. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. First of all, I am so happy that the dishwasher came in. The #1 best purchase since moving is the LG TV, and #2 is the LG dishwasher~ I am recommending it to people around me. The design is also neat and pretty with a matte beige color (+). This is an additional review after using it for 3 months. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

Those who have a large family and eat a full bowl even after eating once. I think 12-person households are too big for one or two people to eat once or twice, so the dishes do not come out much. I eat two meals a day, so I run it almost every two days, so it is just right for a two-person household that eats home. It is not difficult to use. The technician explained it in detail for more than 10 minutes. I think it was a good decision to buy a model with a three-tier cutlery tray. There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. Since it is a WIFI-enabled model, I connected it to WIFI and linked it to the LG app. There is a lot of information such as the exact usage method of the dishwasher, courses, and number of uses, so I recommend downloading the app. When connected to WIFI, the app notifies you when it is finished. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. The design is also neat and pretty with a matte beige color (+). This is an additional review after using it for 3 months. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

Those who have a large family and eat a full bowl even after eating once. I think 12-person households are too big for one or two people to eat once or twice, so the dishes do not come out much. I eat two meals a day, so I run it almost every two days, so it is just right for a two-person household that eats home. It is not difficult to use. The technician explained it in detail for more than 10 minutes. I think it was a good decision to buy a model with a three-tier cutlery tray. There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. Since it is a WIFI-enabled model, I connected it to WIFI and linked it to the LG app. There is a lot of information such as the exact usage method of the dishwasher, courses, and number of uses, so I recommend downloading the app. When connected to WIFI, the app notifies you when it is finished. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. First of all, I am so happy that the dishwasher came in. The #1 best purchase since moving is the LG TV, and #2 is the LG dishwasher~ I am recommending it to people around me. The design is also neat and pretty with a matte beige color (+). This is an additional review after using it for 3 months. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

Those who have a large family and eat a full bowl even after eating once. I think 12-person households are too big for one or two people to eat once or twice, so the dishes do not come out much. I eat two meals a day, so I run it almost every two days, so it is just right for a two-person household that eats home. It is not difficult to use. The technician explained it in detail for more than 10 minutes. I think it was a good decision to buy a model with a three-tier cutlery tray. There seems to be more space for pots and frying pans with or without a separate spoon compartment. I recommend the 3-tier tray. Since it is a WIFI-enabled model, I connected it to WIFI and linked it to the LG app. There is a lot of information such as the exact usage method of the dishwasher, courses, and number of uses, so I recommend downloading the app. When connected to WIFI, the app notifies you when it is finished. I was worried because there were a lot of dishes that were told not to put in the dishwasher, but when I actually used it, it was all there, such as microwaveable side dish containers and dishes that don't mind if the printing comes off if it's not sterilized at high temperature and run at standard speed. A wooden cutting board and knife are enough to wash the dishes by hand to extend the life of the dishware. These days, tablet type is popular, but I use liquid detergent because it is cost-effective. It cleans well with just detergent~ It is clean and uses less water and detergent. The owner told me to add salt for softening the water and gave me a funnel and instructions on how to use it. First of all, I am so happy that the dishwasher came in. The #1 best purchase since moving is the LG TV, and #2 is the LG dishwasher~ I am recommending it to people around me. The design is also neat and pretty with a matte beige color (+). This is an additional review after using it for 3 months. Liquid detergent for dishwashers I add dishwasher-specific detergent for 2-3 months and salt for dishwashers every month. I thought it wouldn't wash well because it came out white like water stains, but it came out clean and clear after adding salt for dishwashers. Since I washed it and put it in, I clean the food strainer once a month and it filters it well. I wonder why I bought a dishwasher only now~ I am very satisfied with the fact that it is a cost-effective model and it does one person's share well. I have more free time in the evening because I spend less time washing dishes ^^ There is no increase in electricity or water bills. Rather, it seems to be less. I highly recommend it to those who are considering a dishwasher~ I am also recommending it to people around me. The matte beige color is pretty and it doesn't bother me at all in terms of interior design.

I'm satisfied :) When I moved, I left the dishwasher I was using before and bought a new one for my current home! The old one was a Chef*Rexion dishwasher. This time, I wanted to buy an LG dishwasher! Even if I use a good dishwasher, I only use the standard one, so I checked the price range and ordered it on Coupang! The color is white and matches my current kitchen! My previous homeowner used an LG dishwasher and took it away, so a space was prepared and the technician just installed it~ Let's compare and analyze it with the old dishwasher~ LG *3-tier structure - 2 turntables (bottom, middle) It seems that only water comes out from the top *Closet and cooking utensil washing compartment is on the top compartment (spoon and chopsticks can be washed individually) *Button on the front of the handle side, *The lower plate compartment folds (easy to put pots in) *There is a separate compartment for solid detergent My previous dishwasher- *2-tier structure - 3 turntables (top, middle, bottom) *The cutlery bin was separate and was placed in the lower compartment (it is impossible to wash each spoon separately) *Button on the top of the handle, *The lower plate compartment does not fold (you have to think of Tetris when putting pots in) *Since there is only one place to put the detergent, solids and liquids have to be put in the same place (sometimes they fall out) There was a big difference for me. First, the button! The button on the LG one is a little inconvenient right now. It's on the front and has a touch button, so while I was cleaning the kitchen, my body touched it and I think I kept touching the cancel button. It was canceled, so I started cleaning again. After that, I lock the button tightly as soon as I start! You have to experience this to know. The existing one had a top button, so it never canceled during cleaning~ Conclusion - If you are satisfied with the price range and don't plan on using many functions, this is a good choice. It can dry at high temperatures. The installer, an LG engineer, called to coordinate the date and installed it, so I was satisfied~ It doesn't seem that expensive models have better cleaning power. If you're going to buy a model without a filter, I recommend it^^ Time LG standard 1 hour 33 minutes Existing one 1 hour 10 minutes Both automatic door openings worked. The cleaning power seems to be similar depending on the detergent you use. Both products are linked to the app, so you get a notification when using them. My current home is a new apartment, so I bought a model without a filter. I know that models with filters are coming out these days, but the filter cost cannot be ignored. I believe there will be no problem because it is heated up when washing. The only thing that is a bit inconvenient is the front button, but I am using it without any other problems~ The electricity bill is similar for both because I use it every day^^

Comments (English): [ I am satisfied with the LG dishwasher~ ] || ---------------- || (My own money) I bought a new one when I moved! I'm satisfied :) When I moved, I left the dishwasher I was using before and bought a new one for my current home! The old one was a Chef*Rexion dishwasher. This time, I wanted to buy an LG dishwasher! Even if I use a good dishwasher, I only use the standard one, so I checked the price range and ordered it on Coupang! The color is white and matches my current kitchen! My previous homeowner used an LG dishwasher and took it away, so a space was prepared and the technician just installed it~ Let's compare and analyze it with the old dishwasher~ LG *3-tier structure - 2 turntables (bottom, middle) It seems that only water comes out from the top *Closet and cooking utensil washing compartment is on the top compartment (spoon and chopsticks can be washed individually) *Button on the front of the handle side, *The lower plate compartment folds (easy to put pots in) *There is a separate compartment for solid detergent My previous dishwasher- *2-tier structure - 3 turntables (top, middle, bottom) *The cutlery bin was separate and was placed in the lower compartment (it is impossible to wash each spoon separately) *Button on the top of the handle, *The lower plate compartment does not fold (you have to think of Tetris when putting pots in) *Since there is only one place to put the detergent, solids and liquids have to be put in the same place (sometimes they fall out) There was a big difference for me. First, the button! The button on the LG one is a little inconvenient right now. It's on the front and has a touch button, so while I was cleaning the kitchen, my body touched it and I think I kept touching the cancel button. It was canceled, so I started cleaning again. After that, I lock the button tightly as soon as I start! You have to experience this to know. The existing one had a top button, so it never canceled during cleaning~ Conclusion - If you are satisfied with the price range and don't plan on using many functions, this is a good choice. It can dry at high temperatures. The installer, an LG engineer, called to coordinate the date and installed it, so I was satisfied~ It doesn't seem that expensive models have better cleaning power. If you're going to buy a model without a filter, I recommend it^^ Time LG standard 1 hour 33 minutes Existing one 1 hour 10 minutes Both automatic door openings worked. The cleaning power seems to be similar depending on the detergent you use. Both products are linked to the app, so you get a notification when using them. My current home is a new apartment, so I bought a model without a filter. I know that models with filters are coming out these days, but the filter cost cannot be ignored. I believe there will be no problem because it is heated up when washing. The only thing that is a bit inconvenient is the front button, but I am using it without any other problems~ The electricity bill is similar for both because I use it every day^^

I'm satisfied :) When I moved, I left the dishwasher I was using before and bought a new one for my current home! The old one was a Chef*Rexion dishwasher. This time, I wanted to buy an LG dishwasher! Even if I use a good dishwasher, I only use the standard one, so I checked the price range and ordered it on Coupang! The color is white and matches my current kitchen! My previous homeowner used an LG dishwasher and took it away, so a space was prepared and the technician just installed it~ Let's compare and analyze it with the old dishwasher~ LG *3-tier structure - 2 turntables (bottom, middle) It seems that only water comes out from the top *Closet and cooking utensil washing compartment is on the top compartment (spoon and chopsticks can be washed individually) *Button on the front of the handle side, *The lower plate compartment folds (easy to put pots in) *There is a separate compartment for solid detergent My previous dishwasher- *2-tier structure - 3 turntables (top, middle, bottom) *The cutlery bin was separate and was placed in the lower compartment (it is impossible to wash each spoon separately) *Button on the top of the handle, *The lower plate compartment does not fold (you have to think of Tetris when putting pots in) *Since there is only one place to put the detergent, solids and liquids have to be put in the same place (sometimes they fall out) There was a big difference for me. First, the button! The button on the LG one is a little inconvenient right now. It's on the front and has a touch button, so while I was cleaning the kitchen, my body touched it and I think I kept touching the cancel button. It was canceled, so I started cleaning again. After that, I lock the button tightly as soon as I start! You have to experience this to know. The existing one had a top button, so it never canceled during cleaning~ Conclusion - If you are satisfied with the price range and don't plan on using many functions, this is a good choice. It can dry at high temperatures. The installer, an LG engineer, called to coordinate the date and installed it, so I was satisfied~ It doesn't seem that expensive models have better cleaning power. The cleaning power seems to be similar depending on the detergent you use. Both products are linked to the app, so you get a notification when using them. After that, I lock the button tightly as soon as I start! You have to experience this to know. The existing one had a top button, so it never canceled during cleaning~ Conclusion - If you are satisfied with the price range and don't plan on using many functions, this is a good choice. I'm satisfied :) When I moved, I left the dishwasher I was using before and bought a new one for my current home! The old one was a Chef*Rexion dishwasher. This time, I wanted to buy an LG dishwasher! Even if I use a good dishwasher, I only use the standard one, so I checked the price range and ordered it on Coupang! The color is white and matches my current kitchen! My previous homeowner used an LG dishwasher and took it away, so a space was prepared and the technician just installed it~ Let's compare and analyze it with the old dishwasher~ LG *3-tier structure - 2 turntables (bottom, middle) It seems that only water comes out from the top *Closet and cooking utensil washing compartment is on the top compartment (spoon and chopsticks can be washed individually) *Button on the front of the handle side, *The lower plate compartment folds (easy to put pots in) *There is a separate compartment for solid detergent My previous dishwasher- *2-tier structure - 3 turntables (top, middle, bottom) *The cutlery bin was separate and was placed in the lower compartment (it is impossible to wash each spoon separately) *Button on the top of the handle, *The lower plate compartment does not fold (you have to think of Tetris when putting pots in) *Since there is only one place to put the detergent, solids and liquids have to be put in the same place (sometimes they fall out) There was a big difference for me. First, the button! The button on the LG one is a little inconvenient right now. It's on the front and has a touch button, so while I was cleaning the kitchen, my body touched it and I think I kept touching the cancel button. It was canceled, so I started cleaning again. After that, I lock the button tightly as soon as I start! You have to experience this to know. The existing one had a top button, so it never canceled during cleaning~ Conclusion - If you are satisfied with the price range and don't plan on using many functions, this is a good choice. It can dry at high temperatures. The installer, an LG engineer, called to coordinate the date and installed it, so I was satisfied~ It doesn't seem that expensive models have better cleaning power. The cleaning power seems to be similar depending on the detergent you use. Both products are linked to the app, so you get a notification when using them. I believe there will be no problem because it is heated up when washing. The only thing that is a bit inconvenient is the front button, but I am using it without any other problems~ The electricity bill is similar for both because I use it every day^^

After that, I lock the button tightly as soon as I start! You have to experience this to know. The existing one had a top button, so it never canceled during cleaning~ Conclusion - If you are satisfied with the price range and don't plan on using many functions, this is a good choice. Product name: Media Countertop App-linked Automatic Door Opening 6-person Dishwasher Advantages Compact size I live alone now, so I didn't need a large size, and since there are many things in the kitchen, a dishwasher that is too large was burdensome, but the size is just right, so it is suitable for small kitchens, apartments, or homes with limited space. Stylish and modern design The clean white exterior matches well with various kitchen interiors. User-friendly operation The intuitive touch control panel makes it easy to select the washing mode. Various washing modes It provides various settings (auto, standard, strong, high temperature wash, rapid) to effectively handle various types of dishes and dust levels. Efficient washing performance It may not be as clean as doing it by hand, but I tried it and was very satisfied! I thought the joy of not doing dishes was too great! Drying function It includes a drying function that saves time and eliminates the need for manual drying. Quiet operation It operates quietly, so it doesn't feel too noisy. Best suited for 1-2 people or small households. Drain hose placement The hose drains directly into the sink, which is unsightly and can create a waterlogged living room if the hose moves. Noisy drain While the machine runs quietly, you can hear the water draining through the hose into the sink. Maintenance required Regular cleaning of the filter and drain system is required to maintain performance, which can be a nuisance for some users. No adjustable racks The interior shelves are fixed, which limits the flexibility for storing large or oddly shaped items, such as baking sheets or oversized pots. Summary Countertop dishwashers are a good choice for those with limited kitchen space and looking for a stylish and efficient appliance. However, their small size and reliance on proper setup may not be suitable for large families or special kitchens.
