Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. Pros Compact design allows installation in small spaces Friendly instructions and work support from the installer Convenient structure that can be used without bending over as it is located on the sink top Power consumption can be checked and washing modes can be added through app linkage Excellent removal of internal moisture with automatic door opening function Clean cleaning power without water stains Water tank method allows simple use without water connection 2-year free warranty service provided Cons Because it must be installed on the sink top, there are concerns about space occupied depending on each household's circumstances It is difficult to wash large pots or frying pans with other dishes due to the capacity for 6 people You should carefully check and rotate the available dishes (sometimes some plastic ones are warped) Overall review Media countertop dishwashers are products that can be easily installed and used in small spaces, and various advantages such as smart app linkage and excellent washing power stood out. In particular, it was more convenient to use when installed next to the dishwashing area. It is the right capacity for small families or households of 2 to 4 people.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  안녕하세요 제품의 상품평을 솔직하게 나누고 싶은 40대 주부 리뷰어 입니다.  ✅ 구매 이유  설거지가 가장 번거로운 집안일 중 하나였어요.  특히 하루를 마무리 하는 저녁식사후 설거지를 하고 나면 기운이 빠지는건 모든 가족의 공통된 과제같아요.  가족 구성원이 많지 않아도 매번 쌓이는 그릇과 컵을 설거지하다 보면 시간이 꽤 걸리더라고요. 저희는 겨울방학을 맞이하여 삼시세끼를 하다보니 손에는 물이 마를날이 없는 나날을 보내고 있어요. 그래서 예전부터 식기세척기에 대한 생각이 많았어요.  주변에서 식기세척기를 사용하는 사람들의 이야기를 들어보면 애벌세척을 하고 식세기에 넣었다 정리하는 과정이 더 번거롭다는 이야기를 듣곤 했거든요. 그러던 중, 쿠팡에서 직수입된 미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기를 사용해 볼 수 있는 기회가 주어져서 사용하게 되었습니다.  ——————————————————————  ✅ 쿠팡설치 기사님들의 친절함  구매 후 설치기사님들께서 방문하셨는데, 정말 친절하고 세심하게 작업해 주셨어요.  식기세척기를 설치하기 좋은 위치를 추천해 주셨고,  정수기를 사용하는 가정에서 배관에서 호스를 따는 방법까지 자세히 설명해 주셨답니다.  덕분에 처음 사용하는 식기세척기임에도 설치부터 사용까지 어렵지 않았어요.  ✅ 디자인과 사용 편의성  이 제품은 카운터탑 위에 올려놓고 사용하는 컴팩트한 크기로, 작은 주방에도 부담 없이 설치할 수 있었어요.  깔끔한 화이트 디자인과 디지털 디스플레이는 모던한 느낌을 줘서 인테리어와도 잘 어울렸답니다. 처음에는 싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 공간을 많이 차지할까 걱정했지만,  설거지하는 바로 옆에 두니 잔여 음식물을 털고 바로 그릇을 넣을 수 있어 너무 편리했어요.  12인용 빌트인 식기세척기에 비해 허리를 굽히지 않아도 되는 점이 특히 마음에 들었답니다.  ✅ 스마트한 앱연동기능  앱 연동 기능이 정말 편리했어요.  스마트폰으로 사용 전력량을 확인하거나 세척 모드를 추가할 수 있어 사용이 훨씬 스마트해졌어요.  ✅ 세척 성능과 세제 사용  이 제품의 세척력은 기대 이상이었어요.  전날 탕수육을 먹고 찐득한 소스가 묻은 접시를 애벌 없이 표준모드로 돌려봤는데,  결과는 아주 만족스러웠답니다. 기름기가 많은 접시나 팬도 뽀득뽀득하게 닦였어요. 쿠팡에서 판매중인 자연퐁 식기세척기용 고체세제를 사용해 보니 물때 없이 깨끗하게 세척되었고,  1캡슐씩 사용하는 방식이라 6인용 식기세척기에 딱 맞아 편리했어요.  ✅ 자동 문열림기능과 소음 소음에 대해 걱정했지만, 생각보다 조용해서 야간에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있었어요.  (저희는 밤에 돌리고 잠들었어요) 세척이 끝나면 자동 문이 열려서 습한것을 제거해주니 편하더라구요. ❗장점 ✔컴팩트한 디자인으로 작은 공간에도 설치 가능 ✔설치기사님의 친절한 설명과 작업 지원 ✔싱크대 상판에 위치하여 허리를 굽히지 않고 사용할 수 있는 편리한 구조 ✔앱 연동으로 전력량 확인 및 세척 모드 추가 가능 ✔자동 문 열림 기능으로 내부 습기 제거 탁월 ✔물때 없이 깨끗한 세척력 ✔워터탱크 방식으로 수도 연결 없이 간단하게 사용 가능 ✔2년 무상보증 서비스 제공  ❗단점 ✔싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 각자의 가정의 형편에 따라 공간 차지가 우려됨 ✔ 6인용 용량으로 큰 냄비나 프라이팬은 다른 그릇과 함께 세척시 많은 양을 세척하기 어려움 ✔사용가능한 그릇을 잘 살펴보고 돌려야 할것(간혹 플라스틱 애들중에 틀어지는 애들이 있다고 하네요)  ✅ 총평  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기는 작은 공간에서도 손쉽게 설치하고 사용할 수 있는 제품으로, 스마트한 앱 연동과 뛰어난 세척력 등 다양한 장점이 돋보였어요. 특히 설거지 공간 옆에 설치하니 사용 편의성이 더 좋았답니다. 소가족이나 2~4인 가구에게 적합한 용량입니다.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. (저희는 밤에 돌리고 잠들었어요) 세척이 끝나면 자동 문이 열려서 습한것을 제거해주니 편하더라구요. ❗장점 ✔컴팩트한 디자인으로 작은 공간에도 설치 가능 ✔설치기사님의 친절한 설명과 작업 지원 ✔싱크대 상판에 위치하여 허리를 굽히지 않고 사용할 수 있는 편리한 구조 ✔앱 연동으로 전력량 확인 및 세척 모드 추가 가능 ✔자동 문 열림 기능으로 내부 습기 제거 탁월 ✔물때 없이 깨끗한 세척력 ✔워터탱크 방식으로 수도 연결 없이 간단하게 사용 가능 ✔2년 무상보증 서비스 제공  ❗단점 ✔싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 각자의 가정의 형편에 따라 공간 차지가 우려됨 ✔ 6인용 용량으로 큰 냄비나 프라이팬은 다른 그릇과 함께 세척시 많은 양을 세척하기 어려움 ✔사용가능한 그릇을 잘 살펴보고 돌려야 할것(간혹 플라스틱 애들중에 틀어지는 애들이 있다고 하네요)  ✅ 총평  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기는 작은 공간에서도 손쉽게 설치하고 사용할 수 있는 제품으로, 스마트한 앱 연동과 뛰어난 세척력 등 다양한 장점이 돋보였어요. 특히 설거지 공간 옆에 설치하니 사용 편의성이 더 좋았답니다. 소가족이나 2~4인 가구에게 적합한 용량입니다.

Sentence (English): Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. In particular, it was more convenient to use when installed next to the dishwashing area. It is the right capacity for small families or households of 2 to 4 people.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  안녕하세요 제품의 상품평을 솔직하게 나누고 싶은 40대 주부 리뷰어 입니다.  ✅ 구매 이유  설거지가 가장 번거로운 집안일 중 하나였어요.  특히 하루를 마무리 하는 저녁식사후 설거지를 하고 나면 기운이 빠지는건 모든 가족의 공통된 과제같아요.  가족 구성원이 많지 않아도 매번 쌓이는 그릇과 컵을 설거지하다 보면 시간이 꽤 걸리더라고요. 저희는 겨울방학을 맞이하여 삼시세끼를 하다보니 손에는 물이 마를날이 없는 나날을 보내고 있어요. 그래서 예전부터 식기세척기에 대한 생각이 많았어요.  주변에서 식기세척기를 사용하는 사람들의 이야기를 들어보면 애벌세척을 하고 식세기에 넣었다 정리하는 과정이 더 번거롭다는 이야기를 듣곤 했거든요. 그러던 중, 쿠팡에서 직수입된 미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기를 사용해 볼 수 있는 기회가 주어져서 사용하게 되었습니다.  ——————————————————————  ✅ 쿠팡설치 기사님들의 친절함  구매 후 설치기사님들께서 방문하셨는데, 정말 친절하고 세심하게 작업해 주셨어요.  식기세척기를 설치하기 좋은 위치를 추천해 주셨고,  정수기를 사용하는 가정에서 배관에서 호스를 따는 방법까지 자세히 설명해 주셨답니다.  덕분에 처음 사용하는 식기세척기임에도 설치부터 사용까지 어렵지 않았어요.  ✅ 디자인과 사용 편의성  이 제품은 카운터탑 위에 올려놓고 사용하는 컴팩트한 크기로, 작은 주방에도 부담 없이 설치할 수 있었어요.  깔끔한 화이트 디자인과 디지털 디스플레이는 모던한 느낌을 줘서 인테리어와도 잘 어울렸답니다. 처음에는 싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 공간을 많이 차지할까 걱정했지만,  설거지하는 바로 옆에 두니 잔여 음식물을 털고 바로 그릇을 넣을 수 있어 너무 편리했어요.  12인용 빌트인 식기세척기에 비해 허리를 굽히지 않아도 되는 점이 특히 마음에 들었답니다.  ✅ 스마트한 앱연동기능  앱 연동 기능이 정말 편리했어요.  스마트폰으로 사용 전력량을 확인하거나 세척 모드를 추가할 수 있어 사용이 훨씬 스마트해졌어요.  ✅ 세척 성능과 세제 사용  이 제품의 세척력은 기대 이상이었어요.  전날 탕수육을 먹고 찐득한 소스가 묻은 접시를 애벌 없이 표준모드로 돌려봤는데,  결과는 아주 만족스러웠답니다. 기름기가 많은 접시나 팬도 뽀득뽀득하게 닦였어요. 쿠팡에서 판매중인 자연퐁 식기세척기용 고체세제를 사용해 보니 물때 없이 깨끗하게 세척되었고,  1캡슐씩 사용하는 방식이라 6인용 식기세척기에 딱 맞아 편리했어요.  ✅ 자동 문열림기능과 소음 소음에 대해 걱정했지만, 생각보다 조용해서 야간에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있었어요.  (저희는 밤에 돌리고 잠들었어요) 세척이 끝나면 자동 문이 열려서 습한것을 제거해주니 편하더라구요. ❗장점 ✔컴팩트한 디자인으로 작은 공간에도 설치 가능 ✔설치기사님의 친절한 설명과 작업 지원 ✔싱크대 상판에 위치하여 허리를 굽히지 않고 사용할 수 있는 편리한 구조 ✔앱 연동으로 전력량 확인 및 세척 모드 추가 가능 ✔자동 문 열림 기능으로 내부 습기 제거 탁월 ✔물때 없이 깨끗한 세척력 ✔워터탱크 방식으로 수도 연결 없이 간단하게 사용 가능 ✔2년 무상보증 서비스 제공  ❗단점 ✔싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 각자의 가정의 형편에 따라 공간 차지가 우려됨 ✔ 6인용 용량으로 큰 냄비나 프라이팬은 다른 그릇과 함께 세척시 많은 양을 세척하기 어려움 ✔사용가능한 그릇을 잘 살펴보고 돌려야 할것(간혹 플라스틱 애들중에 틀어지는 애들이 있다고 하네요)  ✅ 총평  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기는 작은 공간에서도 손쉽게 설치하고 사용할 수 있는 제품으로, 스마트한 앱 연동과 뛰어난 세척력 등 다양한 장점이 돋보였어요. 특히 설거지 공간 옆에 설치하니 사용 편의성이 더 좋았답니다. 소가족이나 2~4인 가구에게 적합한 용량입니다.

Sentence (English): Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  안녕하세요 제품의 상품평을 솔직하게 나누고 싶은 40대 주부 리뷰어 입니다.  ✅ 구매 이유  설거지가 가장 번거로운 집안일 중 하나였어요.  특히 하루를 마무리 하는 저녁식사후 설거지를 하고 나면 기운이 빠지는건 모든 가족의 공통된 과제같아요.  가족 구성원이 많지 않아도 매번 쌓이는 그릇과 컵을 설거지하다 보면 시간이 꽤 걸리더라고요. 저희는 겨울방학을 맞이하여 삼시세끼를 하다보니 손에는 물이 마를날이 없는 나날을 보내고 있어요. 그래서 예전부터 식기세척기에 대한 생각이 많았어요.  주변에서 식기세척기를 사용하는 사람들의 이야기를 들어보면 애벌세척을 하고 식세기에 넣었다 정리하는 과정이 더 번거롭다는 이야기를 듣곤 했거든요. 그러던 중, 쿠팡에서 직수입된 미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기를 사용해 볼 수 있는 기회가 주어져서 사용하게 되었습니다.  ——————————————————————  ✅ 쿠팡설치 기사님들의 친절함  구매 후 설치기사님들께서 방문하셨는데, 정말 친절하고 세심하게 작업해 주셨어요.  식기세척기를 설치하기 좋은 위치를 추천해 주셨고,  정수기를 사용하는 가정에서 배관에서 호스를 따는 방법까지 자세히 설명해 주셨답니다.  덕분에 처음 사용하는 식기세척기임에도 설치부터 사용까지 어렵지 않았어요.  ✅ 디자인과 사용 편의성  이 제품은 카운터탑 위에 올려놓고 사용하는 컴팩트한 크기로, 작은 주방에도 부담 없이 설치할 수 있었어요.  깔끔한 화이트 디자인과 디지털 디스플레이는 모던한 느낌을 줘서 인테리어와도 잘 어울렸답니다. 처음에는 싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 공간을 많이 차지할까 걱정했지만,  설거지하는 바로 옆에 두니 잔여 음식물을 털고 바로 그릇을 넣을 수 있어 너무 편리했어요.  12인용 빌트인 식기세척기에 비해 허리를 굽히지 않아도 되는 점이 특히 마음에 들었답니다.  ✅ 스마트한 앱연동기능  앱 연동 기능이 정말 편리했어요.  스마트폰으로 사용 전력량을 확인하거나 세척 모드를 추가할 수 있어 사용이 훨씬 스마트해졌어요.  ✅ 세척 성능과 세제 사용  이 제품의 세척력은 기대 이상이었어요.  전날 탕수육을 먹고 찐득한 소스가 묻은 접시를 애벌 없이 표준모드로 돌려봤는데,  결과는 아주 만족스러웠답니다. 기름기가 많은 접시나 팬도 뽀득뽀득하게 닦였어요. 쿠팡에서 판매중인 자연퐁 식기세척기용 고체세제를 사용해 보니 물때 없이 깨끗하게 세척되었고,  1캡슐씩 사용하는 방식이라 6인용 식기세척기에 딱 맞아 편리했어요.  ✅ 자동 문열림기능과 소음 소음에 대해 걱정했지만, 생각보다 조용해서 야간에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있었어요.  (저희는 밤에 돌리고 잠들었어요) 세척이 끝나면 자동 문이 열려서 습한것을 제거해주니 편하더라구요. ❗장점 ✔컴팩트한 디자인으로 작은 공간에도 설치 가능 ✔설치기사님의 친절한 설명과 작업 지원 ✔싱크대 상판에 위치하여 허리를 굽히지 않고 사용할 수 있는 편리한 구조 ✔앱 연동으로 전력량 확인 및 세척 모드 추가 가능 ✔자동 문 열림 기능으로 내부 습기 제거 탁월 ✔물때 없이 깨끗한 세척력 ✔워터탱크 방식으로 수도 연결 없이 간단하게 사용 가능 ✔2년 무상보증 서비스 제공  ❗단점 ✔싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 각자의 가정의 형편에 따라 공간 차지가 우려됨 ✔ 6인용 용량으로 큰 냄비나 프라이팬은 다른 그릇과 함께 세척시 많은 양을 세척하기 어려움 ✔사용가능한 그릇을 잘 살펴보고 돌려야 할것(간혹 플라스틱 애들중에 틀어지는 애들이 있다고 하네요)  ✅ 총평  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기는 작은 공간에서도 손쉽게 설치하고 사용할 수 있는 제품으로, 스마트한 앱 연동과 뛰어난 세척력 등 다양한 장점이 돋보였어요. 특히 설거지 공간 옆에 설치하니 사용 편의성이 더 좋았답니다. 소가족이나 2~4인 가구에게 적합한 용량입니다.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. In particular, it was more convenient to use when installed next to the dishwashing area. It is the right capacity for small families or households of 2 to 4 people.

(저희는 밤에 돌리고 잠들었어요) 세척이 끝나면 자동 문이 열려서 습한것을 제거해주니 편하더라구요. ❗장점 ✔컴팩트한 디자인으로 작은 공간에도 설치 가능 ✔설치기사님의 친절한 설명과 작업 지원 ✔싱크대 상판에 위치하여 허리를 굽히지 않고 사용할 수 있는 편리한 구조 ✔앱 연동으로 전력량 확인 및 세척 모드 추가 가능 ✔자동 문 열림 기능으로 내부 습기 제거 탁월 ✔물때 없이 깨끗한 세척력 ✔워터탱크 방식으로 수도 연결 없이 간단하게 사용 가능 ✔2년 무상보증 서비스 제공  ❗단점 ✔싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 각자의 가정의 형편에 따라 공간 차지가 우려됨 ✔ 6인용 용량으로 큰 냄비나 프라이팬은 다른 그릇과 함께 세척시 많은 양을 세척하기 어려움 ✔사용가능한 그릇을 잘 살펴보고 돌려야 할것(간혹 플라스틱 애들중에 틀어지는 애들이 있다고 하네요)  ✅ 총평  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기는 작은 공간에서도 손쉽게 설치하고 사용할 수 있는 제품으로, 스마트한 앱 연동과 뛰어난 세척력 등 다양한 장점이 돋보였어요. 특히 설거지 공간 옆에 설치하니 사용 편의성이 더 좋았답니다. 소가족이나 2~4인 가구에게 적합한 용량입니다.

Sentence (English): Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. In particular, it was more convenient to use when installed next to the dishwashing area. It is the right capacity for small families or households of 2 to 4 people.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. Sentence (English): I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. (저희는 밤에 돌리고 잠들었어요) 세척이 끝나면 자동 문이 열려서 습한것을 제거해주니 편하더라구요. ❗장점 ✔컴팩트한 디자인으로 작은 공간에도 설치 가능 ✔설치기사님의 친절한 설명과 작업 지원 ✔싱크대 상판에 위치하여 허리를 굽히지 않고 사용할 수 있는 편리한 구조 ✔앱 연동으로 전력량 확인 및 세척 모드 추가 가능 ✔자동 문 열림 기능으로 내부 습기 제거 탁월 ✔물때 없이 깨끗한 세척력 ✔워터탱크 방식으로 수도 연결 없이 간단하게 사용 가능 ✔2년 무상보증 서비스 제공  ❗단점 ✔싱크대 상판에 설치해야 해서 각자의 가정의 형편에 따라 공간 차지가 우려됨 ✔ 6인용 용량으로 큰 냄비나 프라이팬은 다른 그릇과 함께 세척시 많은 양을 세척하기 어려움 ✔사용가능한 그릇을 잘 살펴보고 돌려야 할것(간혹 플라스틱 애들중에 틀어지는 애들이 있다고 하네요)  ✅ 총평  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기는 작은 공간에서도 손쉽게 설치하고 사용할 수 있는 제품으로, 스마트한 앱 연동과 뛰어난 세척력 등 다양한 장점이 돋보였어요. 특히 설거지 공간 옆에 설치하니 사용 편의성이 더 좋았답니다. 소가족이나 2~4인 가구에게 적합한 용량입니다.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello, I am a reviewer in my 40s who wants to share my honest product review. Reason for purchase Washing dishes was one of the most troublesome household chores. Especially after washing dishes after dinner at the end of the day, I feel exhausted. It seems to be a common task for all families. Even if there are not many family members, it takes a lot of time to wash the dishes and cups that pile up every time. Since we are having three meals a day during winter vacation, we spend our days without water on our hands. That is why I have thought a lot about dishwashers. When I listened to people around me who use dishwashers, I often heard that the process of pre-washing, putting it in the dishwasher, and organizing it was more troublesome. Then, I was given the opportunity to use the media countertop dishwasher imported directly from Coupang, so I used it. The kindness of Coupang installation technicians After purchasing, the installation technicians visited and worked very kindly and meticulously. They recommended a good location to install the dishwasher and explained in detail how to remove the hose from the pipe in a household that uses a water purifier. Thanks to this, even though it was my first dishwasher, it was easy to install and use. Design and ease of use This product is compact enough to be placed on the countertop, so it was easy to install in a small kitchen. The clean white design and digital display gave it a modern feel, so it went well with the interior. At first, I was worried that it would take up a lot of space because it had to be installed on the sink top, but it was very convenient because I could shake off any remaining food and put the dishes right away when I put it right next to the dishwasher. I especially liked the fact that I didn't have to bend over compared to a 12-person built-in dishwasher. Smart app linkage The app linkage function was really convenient. You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I washed the dishes that had sticky sauce on them after eating sweet and sour pork the day before on standard mode without larvae, and the results were very satisfactory. Even greasy plates and pans were cleaned cleanly. I used the Natural Pong dishwasher solid detergent sold at Coupang, and it was washed cleanly without any water stains, and since it is a one-capsule type, it is perfect for a six-person dishwasher, which is convenient. I was worried about the automatic door opening function and noise, but it was quieter than I thought, so I could use it at night without any worries. (We turned it on at night and went to sleep.) It was convenient because the automatic door opens after washing to remove moisture. In particular, it was more convenient to use when installed next to the dishwashing area. It is the right capacity for small families or households of 2 to 4 people.

You can check the power usage or add a cleaning mode with your smartphone, so it's much smarter to use. Cleaning performance and detergent use This product's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. I am writing this review after using the Media Countertop Dishwasher for a few days. I am very satisfied with the results. This model is convenient because it is linked to an app and can be easily operated via smartphone, but I have not linked it yet, but I plan to try it soon^^ This dishwasher has an automatic door opening function, so after the dishes are washed, the door opens automatically and dries them efficiently, which is the best~ Please refer to the part in the video where the door opens!^^ It is a size for 6 people, and the design and color are also very pretty. The ivory color matches the kitchen interior and gives a very neat and sophisticated feel. However! Since it is a dishwasher, cleaning is the most important, right? If you look at the pictures, you can see the comparison pictures I uploaded before and after cleaning. The cleaning performance is excellent. I really like it. There are various cleaning programs such as standard, strong, high-temperature cleaning, and rapid modes, so you can use them according to the situation. It was also good that there was a separate drying mode. I live in a household of 3, so it was just right for lunch and dinner dishes. I rinsed the lunch dishes in water once. I just put the dinner dishes in right away. At first, I didn't have high expectations, but after using it, I was very satisfied. I especially like the fact that it saves time in these busy times. I put various dishes in it and wondered if the cleaning power would be good. I asked my family's reactions, and they were all very satisfied. It seems to be suitable for a household of 2-3 people. If you use it for every meal, it would be okay for a household of 4-5 people. Oh! I only used the standard mode. After washing, there was still moisture, so I opened it wide and dried it before putting it away. Otherwise, you can put it away right away by running it in the drying mode again. This model is convenient because it is linked to an app and can be easily operated via smartphone, but I have not linked it yet, but I plan to try it soon^^ This dishwasher has an automatic door opening function, so after the dishes are washed, the door opens automatically and dries them efficiently, which is the best~ Please refer to the part in the video where the door opens!^^ It is a size for 6 people, and the design and color are also very pretty. The ivory color matches the kitchen interior and gives a very neat and sophisticated feel. However! Since it is a dishwasher, cleaning is the most important, right? If you look at the pictures, you can see the comparison pictures I uploaded before and after cleaning. The cleaning performance is excellent. I really like it. There are various cleaning programs such as standard, strong, high-temperature cleaning, and rapid modes, so you can use them according to the situation. It was also good that there was a separate drying mode. I live in a household of 3, so it was just right for lunch and dinner dishes. I rinsed the lunch dishes in water once. I just put the dinner dishes in right away. At first, I didn't have high expectations, but after using it, I was very satisfied. I especially like the fact that it saves time in these busy times. I put various dishes in it and wondered if the cleaning power would be good. I asked my family's reactions, and they were all very satisfied. It seems to be suitable for a household of 2-3 people. I'm very happy to have found a good product, and I plan to use it well in the future. In addition, it is very easy to install, and the manual is friendly, so even first-time users can use it easily. I recommend this product because it is satisfactory in many ways.
Comments (Original): [ 만족스러운 식세기입니다 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기를  며칠간 사용해 보고 후기남깁니다.   결과는  매우 만족이에요. 이 모델은 앱과 연동되어 스마트폰을 통해 쉽게 작동할 수 있어 편리하다는데 저는 아직 연동하지 않았는데 조만간 해보려구요^^ 이 식기세척기는 자동문 열림 기능이 있어 식기가 다 씻긴 후 자동으로 문이 열려 효율적으로 건조를  해줘서 가장 좋아요~ 동영상에  문이  띡! 열리는 부분참고해 주세요^^  6인용 크기인데  디자인과 색상도 너무 예쁘더라구요. 아이보리 색상은 주방 인테리어와 조화를 이루어 매우 깔끔하고 세련된 느낌이에요.  하지만! 식기세척기이니 세척이  가장 중요하겠죠? 사진을 보시면 제가 세척 전과 후 비교사진  올린거 보실 수 있어요.  세척 성능이 아주 탁월해요. 완전 맘에 듭니다. 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속모드로 다양한 세척 프로그램이 있어 상황에 맞춰 사용할 수 있구요. 건조모드만  따로 있는것도 좋았답니다. 저는 3인 가구인데 점심과 저녁  설거지거리  넣으면 적당했어요.   점심설거지는 물에 한번헹궈놨구요. 저녁설거지는 그냥 바로  집어넣었어요. 처음에 별  기대가 없었는데 사용해보니 만족도가 매우 높습니다.  특히 요즘같이 바쁜 일상에서 시간을 절약할 수 있는 점이 마음에 듭니다.  이것저것 설거지거리를  넣어보고 과연 세척력이 좋을까? 하고  가족들의 반응을 봤는데, 모두들 매우 만족했고 2~3인 가정에 어울린 것 같아요. 매끼니마다  돌리시는 분은 4~5인 가정도 괜찮을 것 같습니다. 아! 저는 표준모드로만 돌렸구요. 세척이 끝난 후 물기가 남아 있어서 활짝 열어두고 물기마른 후에 정리했어요. 아니면 건조모드로 한번 더 돌리면 바로 정리가능하답니다. 좋은 제품을 알게 되어 매우 기쁘고, 향후에도 잘 사용할 예정입니다.  추가로, 설치도 매우 간편하고, 설명서가 친절하여 처음 사용하는 사람도 쉽게 사용할 수 있습니다. 이처럼 여러 면에서 만족스러운 제품이라  추천합니다.

This model is convenient because it is linked to an app and can be easily operated via smartphone, but I have not linked it yet, but I plan to try it soon^^ This dishwasher has an automatic door opening function, so after the dishes are washed, the door opens automatically and dries them efficiently, which is the best~ Please refer to the part in the video where the door opens!^^ It is a size for 6 people, and the design and color are also very pretty. The ivory color matches the kitchen interior and gives a very neat and sophisticated feel. However! Since it is a dishwasher, cleaning is the most important, right? If you look at the pictures, you can see the comparison pictures I uploaded before and after cleaning. The cleaning performance is excellent. I really like it. There are various cleaning programs such as standard, strong, high-temperature cleaning, and rapid modes, so you can use them according to the situation. It was also good that there was a separate drying mode. I live in a household of 3, so it was just right for lunch and dinner dishes. I rinsed the lunch dishes in water once. I just put the dinner dishes in right away. At first, I didn't have high expectations, but after using it, I was very satisfied. I especially like the fact that it saves time in these busy times. I put various dishes in it and wondered if the cleaning power would be good. I asked my family's reactions, and they were all very satisfied. It seems to be suitable for a household of 2-3 people. If you use it for every meal, it would be okay for a household of 4-5 people. Oh! I only used the standard mode. After washing, there was still moisture, so I opened it wide and dried it before putting it away. Otherwise, you can put it away right away by running it in the drying mode again. I'm very happy to have found a good product, and I plan to use it well in the future. In addition, it is very easy to install, and the manual is friendly, so even first-time users can use it easily. I recommend this product because it is satisfactory in many ways.
Comments (Original): [ 만족스러운 식세기입니다 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기를  며칠간 사용해 보고 후기남깁니다.   결과는  매우 만족이에요. 이 모델은 앱과 연동되어 스마트폰을 통해 쉽게 작동할 수 있어 편리하다는데 저는 아직 연동하지 않았는데 조만간 해보려구요^^ 이 식기세척기는 자동문 열림 기능이 있어 식기가 다 씻긴 후 자동으로 문이 열려 효율적으로 건조를  해줘서 가장 좋아요~ 동영상에  문이  띡! 열리는 부분참고해 주세요^^  6인용 크기인데  디자인과 색상도 너무 예쁘더라구요. 아이보리 색상은 주방 인테리어와 조화를 이루어 매우 깔끔하고 세련된 느낌이에요.  하지만! 식기세척기이니 세척이  가장 중요하겠죠? 사진을 보시면 제가 세척 전과 후 비교사진  올린거 보실 수 있어요.  세척 성능이 아주 탁월해요. 완전 맘에 듭니다. 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속모드로 다양한 세척 프로그램이 있어 상황에 맞춰 사용할 수 있구요. 건조모드만  따로 있는것도 좋았답니다. 저는 3인 가구인데 점심과 저녁  설거지거리  넣으면 적당했어요.   점심설거지는 물에 한번헹궈놨구요. 저녁설거지는 그냥 바로  집어넣었어요. 처음에 별  기대가 없었는데 사용해보니 만족도가 매우 높습니다.  특히 요즘같이 바쁜 일상에서 시간을 절약할 수 있는 점이 마음에 듭니다.  이것저것 설거지거리를  넣어보고 과연 세척력이 좋을까? 하고  가족들의 반응을 봤는데, 모두들 매우 만족했고 2~3인 가정에 어울린 것 같아요. 매끼니마다  돌리시는 분은 4~5인 가정도 괜찮을 것 같습니다. 아! 저는 표준모드로만 돌렸구요. 세척이 끝난 후 물기가 남아 있어서 활짝 열어두고 물기마른 후에 정리했어요. 아니면 건조모드로 한번 더 돌리면 바로 정리가능하답니다. 좋은 제품을 알게 되어 매우 기쁘고, 향후에도 잘 사용할 예정입니다.  추가로, 설치도 매우 간편하고, 설명서가 친절하여 처음 사용하는 사람도 쉽게 사용할 수 있습니다. 이처럼 여러 면에서 만족스러운 제품이라  추천합니다.

Recently, while considering a dishwasher to use in the office, I chose the Media Countertop Dishwasher, and it was an excellent choice. First of all, the simple yet luxurious design of the product goes well with any interior. It creates a neat and sophisticated atmosphere whether in the kitchen or the office. 1. Design and size The modern design in white color had the effect of making the space look brighter and more spacious. The compact size is perfect for narrow spaces, and it was a perfect size for washing frequently used dishes such as cups and plates. 2. App linkage and smart function This product is not just a dishwasher, but also provides a smart function that can be linked to the app. It was really convenient because I could check the washing status or control the washing mode on my smartphone. It was especially efficient to use in a busy office environment. 3. Cleaning performance The most important thing in a dishwasher is the cleaning power! This product exceeded my expectations. I used both the standard and strong cleaning modes, and it cleaned even the dishes with sweet and sour pork sauce on them and the pans that were covered in oil. In particular, I was really satisfied with the fact that it washes cleanly enough to make a squeaking sound even without larval washing. 4. Automatic door opening and drying function Thanks to the function that the door opens automatically after washing, the internal moisture is naturally discharged and it is finished cleanly by drying. It was really convenient because I could clean it up right away without having to wipe the moisture separately. 5. Noise and installation convenience The operating noise was almost imperceptible, so it did not disturb the work space. Installation was also very easy, and thanks to the friendly installation technician's guidance, even first-time users were able to adapt easily. Overall review The media countertop dishwasher is the best item that has greatly reduced the stress of washing dishes in a busy office life. I am completely satisfied with the design, function, and cleaning power, and I highly recommend it for households of 2 to 4 people or office environments!
Comments (Original): [ 세련된 디자인과 뛰어난 세척력! ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  최근 사무실에서 사용할 식기세척기를 고민하던 중, 미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기를 선택했는데, 정말 탁월한 선택이었습니다. 우선 제품의 심플하면서 고급스러운 디자인은 어떤 인테리어에도 잘 어울립니다. 주방이든 사무실이든 깔끔하고 세련된 분위기를 만들어 주더라고요.  1. 디자인과 크기 화이트 색상의 모던한 디자인 덕분에 공간을 더욱 밝고 넓어 보이게 만들어 주는 효과가 있었습니다. 크기가 컴팩트해서 좁은 공간에도 딱 알맞은데, 컵이나 접시처럼 자주 사용하는 식기를 세척하기에는 정말 적합한 크기였습니다.  2. 앱 연동 및 스마트 기능 이 제품은 단순히 식기세척기에 그치지 않고, 앱과 연동할 수 있는 스마트 기능까지 제공됩니다. 세척 상태를 스마트폰으로 확인하거나 세척 모드를 제어할 수 있어서 정말 편리했습니다. 특히 업무가 바쁜 사무실 환경에서도 효율적으로 사용할 수 있었습니다.  3. 세척 성능 식기세척기에서 가장 중요한 세척력! 이 제품은 기대 이상이었어요. 표준 세척 모드와 강력 세척 모드 모두 사용해봤는데, 탕수육 소스가 묻은 접시나 기름기가 잔뜩 묻은 팬까지 깨끗하게 세척해 줬습니다. 특히 애벌 세척 없이도 뽀득뽀득 소리가 날 정도로 깔끔하게 세척되는 점이 정말 만족스러웠습니다.  4. 자동 문 열림 및 건조 기능 세척이 끝난 후 자동으로 문이 열리는 기능 덕분에 내부 습기가 자연스럽게 배출되어 건조까지 깔끔하게 마무리됩니다. 따로 물기를 닦을 필요 없이 바로 정리할 수 있어 정말 간편했습니다.  5. 소음과 설치 편의성 작동 소음이 거의 느껴지지 않아 업무 공간에서도 방해되지 않았습니다. 설치도 매우 간편했으며, 친절한 설치 기사님의 안내 덕분에 처음 사용하는 사람도 쉽게 적응할 수 있었습니다.  총평 미디어 카운터탑 식기세척기는 바쁜 사무실 생활 속에서 설거지 스트레스를 확 줄여 준 최고의 아이템이에요. 디자인, 기능, 세척력 모든 면에서 완벽하게 만족하며, 2~4인 가구나 사무실 환경에 강력 추천합니다!

Comments (English): [ I finally invited my aunt~! ^^ ] || ---------------- || Samsung Electronics Bespoke Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher 14-person I wanted to free my husband from his main job of washing dishes, so I bought a dishwasher for one of my three aunts. I tried it for a month at my sister's house living abroad and it was really convenient. There were many days when I really didn't want to do the dishes when they piled up in the evening, but now I can just collect them and do it all at once in the evening, so it's really convenient. At first, I felt guilty about collecting the dishes like this? I guess I'll get used to it. My sink is gray, so I ordered Kota Charcoal, but after installing it, it camouflaged itself almost like a chameleon. It's really perfect, like a built-in dishwasher from the beginning. The sink repairman came first a day after I ordered it, and the dishwasher installation technician came the next day, so it was installed in no time. The sink had to be cut down, so there was an additional cost of 90,000 won. They worked on it for about 1 hour and 30 minutes, but even though they cleaned up the hallway and the front door, there was a lot of wood dust, so I had to wipe it with a wet tissue for 30 minutes. I wish they had laid down something like vinyl when they worked. That was the most disappointing part. The installation was finished in about 30 minutes, and they gave me an explanation before they left. After using it, I regret why I bought it sooner. It's really, really convenient! It has various functions, but I mainly use the standard course and occasionally use the strong dry mode. The installer said that the dishwasher doesn't use much electricity even if I run it every day. He said that it also saves a lot of water compared to washing dishes by hand. He said that if there is a fishy smell or water stains, you can add vinegar, salt, and citric acid and wash it thoroughly. I should wash it thoroughly once a month too!

Comments (English): [ So Easy to Use, So Quiet, So Nicely Made!  ] || ---------------- || I was drawn to the simplicity of my new dishwasher -- simple lines, simple buttons to set up how you want to wash dishes, whether you just put them into the dishwasher right after you clear the dishes from the dinner table or they had been sitting in the dishwasher until you generated more dirty dishes for a full load. I have found that most dishes and cups and pots and pans for a large meal all fit into my dishwasher and one selling point for me was the huge utensil basket on the lower dish rack. It is TWICE as big as the one in my old loud dishwasher! I have plenty of room for sharp knives, utensils, ice cream scoops, scissors, serving spoons, etc. After the wash and dry cycles, all you have to do is grab the handle of this plastic utensil basket and walk it over to whatever drawer you will be putting the utensils into, and it takes just a few minutes. There are so many things I like about this dishwasher --like how easy it is to pick out what kind of washer/dryer settings you want for the best cleaning results. I like the option of the power blast cycle for my pots and pans. Sentence (English): We bough this dishwasher in 2019.
Comments (English): [ Needs to be a recall - Unit goes dead no power ] || ---------------- || We bough this dishwasher in 2019. Approximately, 2 years ago the dishwasher would go completely dead. After spending hours testing the motherboard and other electrical components, I gave up and turned the breaker back on and the dishwasher came to life again. Since then, every so often the dishwasher would go dead (no lights, nothing) and the fix has been to turn the breaker off for 1 hour or longer and then it would function again. Now, the breaker reset is not working and is completely dead. Reading the reviews on here and reading the replies from GE, it seems GE knows about this issue and even suggested to unplug (turn the breaker off) and plug back in as a fix. There should be a complete recall of the motherboard as the dishwasher was only 4 years old when this started happening. We now have to buy a brand new dishwasher and won't be able to buy another GE product as we are afraid we will have the same issue.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher because it had a third rack and did not have bitumen insulation (dishwashers with bitumen insulation smell bad to me).
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher because it had a third rack and did not have bitumen insulation (dishwashers with bitumen insulation smell bad to me). It's been a good purchase. It's quiet, cleans well, and is easy to stack and service. I use gel or powdered detergent (no tabs) and run the kitchen faucet until the water is truly hot before starting the dishwasher as a general rule of thumb (thanks to the Tech Connections guy on YouTube for the helpful tips on this), and get excellent performance from this dishwasher. It is designed to use rinse aid for complete drying. Because I don't use rinse aid, I need to either leave the door cracked for a bit after the cycle ends or to towel dry some items, which is fine by me.

It was a little short for a family of 6, but I used it well enough, but when I moved, I wanted to buy a neat built-in one. So I waited for a hot deal and got it for around 500,000 won. I'll write down what I felt after using it for about two months. The 2-tier is also good! I think many of you are wondering whether this product is 2-tier or 3-tier? So in the end, the difference is whether you put it vertically (2-tier) or horizontally (3-tier). Of course, the 3-tier one has much better storage capacity for cutlery and cooking utensils, but I'm a housewife who thinks it's a waste to spend 100,000 won for that little bit of convenience. Even with the 3-tier one, you can wash cooking utensils sufficiently by putting them in the cutlery holder and other empty spaces. It has good cleaning power! * I didn't think it would be much different from the 6-person one, but the cleaning power is definitely better. In the past, I would always wash the dishes thoroughly and put them in, but with this product, you can simply take out the food and run it and it cleans well. And a few days after purchasing it, my mom spilled a ton of rice powder, but it was cleaned well by running the dishwasher except for the gaps where the water didn't reach. The drying is weak. If you run it on the basic mode, it takes about an hour to clean, and if you run it on hot air for about an hour?, there is more moisture left than you think. So I usually leave it wide open and sleep. Then, it dries well overnight, and I think it helps with the humidity in the house! When there isn't much, you can run it separately in the upper and lower parts. Why would you want to fill up the dishwasher space anyway, so let's run it full! If you don't have much to wash after one or two meals, you just keep piling them up? But it's good that you can run it separately in the upper and lower parts! It saves time and water! My back doesn't hurt when I put the dishes in! I was worried about this because my joints are weak. I was worried that my back would hurt if I had to bend over to use the built-in after using the countertop comfortably, but it was a needless worry. Other than that, the only minor regret is that it is not a Wi-Fi-supported model, so it cannot be connected to the LG TinQ app? Anyway, I am very satisfied with it for the price! Comments (English): [ A cost-effective model that remains true to the original function of a dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Let me explain why I chose the LG Dishwasher DUBJ1EP. * Reason for choosing LG LG Dishwasher Dishwasher brands include Cuckoo, SK Magic, LG, and Samsung. Cuckoo can be purchased for around 300,000 won without the 12-person automatic door opening function. SK Magic is similar in price to LG and Samsung, but has good performance in the dishwasher field. LG dishwashers are produced domestically. 12-person dishwashers have better reviews than 6-person ones. Samsung dishwashers have been produced as a Chinese OEM since 2007 and sold in Korea. * 12-person VS 6-person A representative 6-person dishwasher is the Samsung Bespoke Countertop model, which can be purchased for around 300,000 won. The capacity of the 6-person one is much smaller than that of the 12-person one. Don't compare them on YouTube or in photos, but go to an actual store and you'll immediately know, 'Ah. I should buy the 12-person one.' Even if you are a newlywed couple living alone, most people strongly recommend the 12-person model. Home appliances are a great deal. * There are so many LG dishwashers. I don't know how much I studied the cost-effective DUBJ1EP LG dishwasher 12-person model. I only buy home appliances online. The models displayed in offline stores are expensive because they are high-performance. I personally think that simple appliances are more durable and long-lasting than those with complex functions, so I only chose basic models for dishwashers and compared them before purchasing them. * Let's remove the hot air drying function. Hot air drying is literally drying quickly with hot air. You can have warm, dry, fluffy dishes. However, it takes longer for the dishwasher to run and costs more electricity. If there is an automatic door opening function, the door opens slightly after washing and the dishes dry without electricity, but it takes longer to dry than with hot air drying. The drying time of dishes varies depending on the humidity in the house and whether or not you use a rinse. I decided to remove the hot air drying function because I don't need to dry them in a hurry. * Let's also remove the high-temperature steam function. You can think of the high-temperature steam function as boiling water at 100 degrees, but most bacteria will die in water temperatures similar to those of a dishwasher, even if it's not 100 degrees. When I thought about when I would need high-temperature steam, I realized that I need to sterilize baby bottles in boiling water for up to 100 days after a newborn. However, I thought it was safer to do it myself, so I decided to remove the high-temperature steam function since I don't think I'll use it often. * DUBJ1E vs. DUBJ1EP A product that I was worried about until the end. The DUBJ1EP costs 600,000 won, and the DUBJ1E costs 700,000 won, making a difference of about 100,000 to 200,000 won. So what's the functional difference? The presence or absence of Wi-Fi and the presence or absence of a 3-tier shelf. I started to worry about whether it should be a 3-tier shelf or a 2-tier shelf. Do I want to pay an extra 100,000 to 200,000 won for a 3-tier shelf? I watched a lot of videos and articles about this, and 90% of the time, the 3-tier shelf was a huge win. In the case of the 3-tier, there is one more tier at the very top where you can put spoons and cooking utensils. In the case of the 2-tier product, there is a spoon holder as shown below, so you can put them in. The difference is that the spoons are spread out at the top of the 3-tier, and in the case of the 2-tier, you can put them in the spoon holder. Also, in the case of the 2-tier, there is a disadvantage that the space for loading dishes is narrow because there is a spoon holder. Are you worried? People who have used the 3-tier cannot use the 2-tier. However, people who have only used the 2-tier can use it without any inconvenience. And because it is a 2-tier, there is an advantage that you can load larger and taller dishes. * Final choice of DUBJ1EP I was going to buy the DUBJ1E, but I really wanted a dishwasher, so I thought about the DUBJ1EP benefits first, so I ended up buying it. When I thought about when I would need high-temperature steam, I realized that I need to sterilize baby bottles in boiling water for up to 100 days after a newborn. However, I thought it was safer to do it myself, so I decided to remove the high-temperature steam function since I don't think I'll use it often. * DUBJ1E vs. DUBJ1EP A product that I was worried about until the end. People who have used the 3-tier cannot use the 2-tier. However, people who have only used the 2-tier can use it without any inconvenience. And because it is a 2-tier, there is an advantage that you can load larger and taller dishes. * Final choice of DUBJ1EP I was going to buy the DUBJ1E, but I really wanted a dishwasher, so I thought about the DUBJ1EP benefits first, so I ended up buying it. I am using it with satisfaction. I hope you found my review helpful!

I am using it with satisfaction. I hope you found my review helpful!

Hot air drying is literally drying quickly with hot air. You can have warm, dry, fluffy dishes. However, it takes longer for the dishwasher to run and costs more electricity. If there is an automatic door opening function, the door opens slightly after washing and the dishes dry without electricity, but it takes longer to dry than with hot air drying. The drying time of dishes varies depending on the humidity in the house and whether or not you use a rinse. I decided to remove the hot air drying function because I don't need to dry them in a hurry. * Let's also remove the high-temperature steam function. You can think of the high-temperature steam function as boiling water at 100 degrees, but most bacteria will die in water temperatures similar to those of a dishwasher, even if it's not 100 degrees. When I thought about when I would need high-temperature steam, I realized that I need to sterilize baby bottles in boiling water for up to 100 days after a newborn. However, I thought it was safer to do it myself, so I decided to remove the high-temperature steam function since I don't think I'll use it often. * DUBJ1E vs. DUBJ1EP A product that I was worried about until the end. Do I want to pay an extra 100,000 to 200,000 won for a 3-tier shelf? I watched a lot of videos and articles about this, and 90% of the time, the 3-tier shelf was a huge win. In the case of the 3-tier, there is one more tier at the very top where you can put spoons and cooking utensils. In the case of the 2-tier product, there is a spoon holder as shown below, so you can put them in. The difference is that the spoons are spread out at the top of the 3-tier, and in the case of the 2-tier, you can put them in the spoon holder. Also, in the case of the 2-tier, there is a disadvantage that the space for loading dishes is narrow because there is a spoon holder. Are you worried? People who have used the 3-tier cannot use the 2-tier. However, people who have only used the 2-tier can use it without any inconvenience. And because it is a 2-tier, there is an advantage that you can load larger and taller dishes. * Final choice of DUBJ1EP I was going to buy the DUBJ1E, but I really wanted a dishwasher, so I thought about the DUBJ1EP benefits first, so I ended up buying it. I am using it with satisfaction. I hope you found my review helpful!

Comments (Original): [ 깔끔한 세척력에 단정한 외관 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.우선 눈에 보이는 디자인이나 외관이 심플하고 아이보리 색상이 고급스럽고 차분해 보이며 어느 공간에 두더라도 잘 어울리는 제품이라 생각됩니다.  사이즈가 컴팩트하기에 좁은 주방 공간에도 살치할 수 있다는것 역시 장점이 되겠군요. 작동 역시 어렵지 않아 사용이 용이하며 세척기 내부가 많은 주방식기들을 수납,세척할 수 있도록 효율적으로 설계 구성되어 있어요.처음 설치하고 바로 오염이 심하지 않고 먼지와 약간의 기름때가 있는 몇개의 식기와 주전자를 시험용으로 세제없이 표준 모드로 작동시켜봤는데 스테인레스 주전자가 깔끔해지는것을 보고 제품이 우수함을 느꼈습니다.소음 부분은 씽크대 상판이 인조대리석 등으로 제작되지 않고 스테인리스로 제작된 씽크대라면 소음이 꽤 심합니다.저는 제 사무실 탕비실에 설치했는데 스테인리스 씽크대 상판이라 꽤 심한 소음에 노출됨을 알게 되었어요.설치 부분에 있어 저는 기존 정수기 연결 부분을 식기세척기의 물이 주입되는 부분으로 대처했는데 (정수기를 사용하지 않음)제품 설치 기사분께서 만약 그 부분이 준비되지 않았다면 제품이 반송되어야한다고 하시는 부분이 의아했어요.이유를 물으니 본인들은 하청받아 설치하기 때문에 다른 부품을 가지고 있지 않다고 했는데 만약 그 부분이 선결되어야 한다면  설치 일자 조율에 관한 전화 통화시 미리 알려주어야 하는 부분일텐데 어떤 선결 내용 고지도 없는것이 아쉬웠답니다.다른 분들의 상품평을 보니 설치비를 지불하면 설치해 준다고 하시는데 왜 안된다는 분들이 계시는지 의아합니다.또 한가지 아쉬운 점을 더 피력하자면 기사분이 담배냄새가 정말 심했습니다.웬만하면 저도 이해하는데 고객에게 설치 서비스를 제공하시는 분이 고객을 하잖게 생각하는것이 아닌가? 하는 불편감이 들었고 고객을 만날때엔 적어도 역한 담배냄새는 좀 조심해야하는것이 서로에 대한 매너가 아닐까 싶습니다.제품이 우수하고 만족스럽더라도 설치하시는 분의 기본적인 부분의 결여로 인하여 제품에 대한 이미지가 평가 절하될수도 있음에 이 부분에 관한 적절한 교육이나 조치가 이루어져야한다고 생각합니다.총평은 제품 만족도는 비할바 없이 좋지만 설치 서비스 부분이 아쉬웠다는것으로 마무리 하겠습니다.

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event.
Comments (English): [ Neat appearance with clean cleaning power ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. The simple design and exterior, along with the luxurious, calming ivory color, make this product a perfect fit for any space. Its compact size also makes it ideal for small kitchens. Operation is straightforward and easy, and the interior is efficiently designed to accommodate and clean a wide variety of kitchenware. Immediately after installation, I tested it on standard mode without detergent on a few dishes that weren't heavily soiled, but still had some dust and grease. I was impressed by how clean the stainless steel kettle became. As for noise, a stainless steel sink, as opposed to something like artificial marble, can be quite noisy. I installed it in my office kitchen, and the stainless steel sink top exposed me to quite a bit of noise. Regarding installation, I replaced the existing water purifier connection with the dishwasher water inlet (I don't use a water purifier). I was puzzled by the installer's claim that if this part wasn't ready, the product would have to be returned. When I asked why, they said they subcontract the installation and therefore don't have any other parts. If this part had to be pre-requisite, they should have mentioned it in advance during the phone call to schedule the installation. I was disappointed that they didn't mention any pre-requisites. Other reviews stated that they would install the product if the installation fee was paid, so I'm puzzled why some people say no. Another thing I found disappointing was that the installer smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. While I understand the situation, it felt like the installer was being disrespectful to the customer. I think it's good manners to be cautious of strong cigarette smells when meeting customers. Even if the product is excellent and satisfactory, a lack of basic installation skills can tarnish the product's image. Therefore, appropriate training and action should be taken to address this issue. I will conclude by saying that while product satisfaction is incomparable, the installation service was disappointing.
Comments (Original): [ 깔끔한 세척력에 단정한 외관 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.우선 눈에 보이는 디자인이나 외관이 심플하고 아이보리 색상이 고급스럽고 차분해 보이며 어느 공간에 두더라도 잘 어울리는 제품이라 생각됩니다.  사이즈가 컴팩트하기에 좁은 주방 공간에도 살치할 수 있다는것 역시 장점이 되겠군요. 작동 역시 어렵지 않아 사용이 용이하며 세척기 내부가 많은 주방식기들을 수납,세척할 수 있도록 효율적으로 설계 구성되어 있어요.처음 설치하고 바로 오염이 심하지 않고 먼지와 약간의 기름때가 있는 몇개의 식기와 주전자를 시험용으로 세제없이 표준 모드로 작동시켜봤는데 스테인레스 주전자가 깔끔해지는것을 보고 제품이 우수함을 느꼈습니다.소음 부분은 씽크대 상판이 인조대리석 등으로 제작되지 않고 스테인리스로 제작된 씽크대라면 소음이 꽤 심합니다.저는 제 사무실 탕비실에 설치했는데 스테인리스 씽크대 상판이라 꽤 심한 소음에 노출됨을 알게 되었어요.설치 부분에 있어 저는 기존 정수기 연결 부분을 식기세척기의 물이 주입되는 부분으로 대처했는데 (정수기를 사용하지 않음)제품 설치 기사분께서 만약 그 부분이 준비되지 않았다면 제품이 반송되어야한다고 하시는 부분이 의아했어요.이유를 물으니 본인들은 하청받아 설치하기 때문에 다른 부품을 가지고 있지 않다고 했는데 만약 그 부분이 선결되어야 한다면  설치 일자 조율에 관한 전화 통화시 미리 알려주어야 하는 부분일텐데 어떤 선결 내용 고지도 없는것이 아쉬웠답니다.다른 분들의 상품평을 보니 설치비를 지불하면 설치해 준다고 하시는데 왜 안된다는 분들이 계시는지 의아합니다.또 한가지 아쉬운 점을 더 피력하자면 기사분이 담배냄새가 정말 심했습니다.웬만하면 저도 이해하는데 고객에게 설치 서비스를 제공하시는 분이 고객을 하잖게 생각하는것이 아닌가? 하는 불편감이 들었고 고객을 만날때엔 적어도 역한 담배냄새는 좀 조심해야하는것이 서로에 대한 매너가 아닐까 싶습니다.제품이 우수하고 만족스럽더라도 설치하시는 분의 기본적인 부분의 결여로 인하여 제품에 대한 이미지가 평가 절하될수도 있음에 이 부분에 관한 적절한 교육이나 조치가 이루어져야한다고 생각합니다.총평은 제품 만족도는 비할바 없이 좋지만 설치 서비스 부분이 아쉬웠다는것으로 마무리 하겠습니다.

Sentence (English): I was impressed by how clean the stainless steel kettle became.
Comments (English): [ Neat appearance with clean cleaning power ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. The simple design and exterior, along with the luxurious, calming ivory color, make this product a perfect fit for any space. Its compact size also makes it ideal for small kitchens. Operation is straightforward and easy, and the interior is efficiently designed to accommodate and clean a wide variety of kitchenware. Immediately after installation, I tested it on standard mode without detergent on a few dishes that weren't heavily soiled, but still had some dust and grease. I was impressed by how clean the stainless steel kettle became. As for noise, a stainless steel sink, as opposed to something like artificial marble, can be quite noisy. I installed it in my office kitchen, and the stainless steel sink top exposed me to quite a bit of noise. Regarding installation, I replaced the existing water purifier connection with the dishwasher water inlet (I don't use a water purifier). I was puzzled by the installer's claim that if this part wasn't ready, the product would have to be returned. When I asked why, they said they subcontract the installation and therefore don't have any other parts. If this part had to be pre-requisite, they should have mentioned it in advance during the phone call to schedule the installation. I was disappointed that they didn't mention any pre-requisites. Other reviews stated that they would install the product if the installation fee was paid, so I'm puzzled why some people say no. Another thing I found disappointing was that the installer smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. While I understand the situation, it felt like the installer was being disrespectful to the customer. I think it's good manners to be cautious of strong cigarette smells when meeting customers. Even if the product is excellent and satisfactory, a lack of basic installation skills can tarnish the product's image. Therefore, appropriate training and action should be taken to address this issue. I will conclude by saying that while product satisfaction is incomparable, the installation service was disappointing.
